下瓦尔登：公众可申请查阅官方文件: Nidwalden: public access to official documents

生效前形成或收到的文件原则上继续按旧规定处理。: Documents created or received before commencement generally remain under the previous rules.

可现场查阅、取得副本或电子获取；无特别工作量的程序免费。: Access may be on site, by copy or electronically; requests without special effort are free.
隐私、商业秘密及优先公共利益可限制公开；未结行政程序、司法案件等不适用。旧文件中: Privacy, business secrets and overriding public interests can restrict access; ongoing administrative and judicial proceedings are excluded. Older legislative explanatory materials have an exception.
格拉鲁斯：班额上限22人，取消最低班额: Glarus: 22-pupil general ceiling and no minimum class size

使用EVEN的项目，完工证明也在平台中完成。: Projects using EVEN also submit completion confirmation within the platform.
业主和负责专业人员须按市镇要求提交能源措施证明；更换供暖同样须申报。: Owners and responsible professionals submit energy documentation to the municipality; heating replacement must also be notified.
此前已经以PDF提交的项目可继续原流程，无需重新录入EVEN。: Projects already submitted as PDFs before the cutoff may finish under the old process without re-entry into EVEN.

市镇和跨市镇气候计划的资助对象、条件及比例计算有了明确规则。: Eligible activities, conditions and grant-rate calculations for municipal and joint climate plans are specified.
这是公共决策和补贴执行规则，不代表每个私人建设项目都须单独接受该测试。: These rules concern public decisions and grants, not an automatic separate climate test for every private building project.
索洛图恩：2026年所得税级距与抵扣额调整: Solothurn: 2026 income-tax brackets and deductions adjusted

抵扣仍须满足上位税法条件；基础税表不等于所有居民的最终税率，也不改联邦税。: Deductions remain conditional; the base tariff is not everyone’s final tax rate and does not change federal tax.

方案配合Justitia 4.0并调整检察辅助人员权限，公众可提交意见。: The draft supports Justitia 4.0 and changes assistant-prosecutor powers; comments can be submitted.

不是全民现金补助；须满足服务认可及必要性要求，补偿机构可要求医生证明。: This is not a universal cash benefit; recognition and necessity requirements apply, and medical certification may be required.

业主应规划改造，并查看补贴和可能的例外条件。: Owners should plan renovations and check grants and exemptions.

保留车票、延误通知、改道沟通和支出凭证；自行购买机票或出租车并不自动适用这项10: Keep tickets, delay notices, rerouting communications and receipts. Self-booked flights or taxis do not automatically qualify under this 100-minute rule.

Through-tickets and separate tickets offer different protection; some domestic services are exempt. Extraordinary circumstances may exclude delay compensation, but do not automatically remove refund, rerouting or assistance rights.

消费者此前未必能在签约网站直接找到明确、持续可用的撤回入口。: Consumers previously lacked a consistently required, clear and accessible withdrawal function.
提供清楚可见且随时可访问的按钮；金融服务客户还可要求直接与工作人员联系。: Providers must offer a clearly visible, accessible button; financial-service consumers may request personal contact.
影响网购消费者、在线服务商及金融服务提供者。: Affects online consumers, retailers and service providers.

购买和租赁均在支持范围内，金额按车型、家庭收入和家庭人数区分。: Purchase and leasing are covered, with amounts depending on vehicle, income and family size.
计划购买或租赁电动车的家庭可核对BAFA条件后申请。: Households can check BAFA eligibility before applying for purchase or lease support.

6月1日起，私人和私法法人可以共同消耗或分享本地产电。: From 1 June, individuals and private-law entities can jointly use locally produced electricity.
政府将本次调整定位为简化当地太阳能使用及电力系统灵活性。: The reform aims to simplify local solar use and improve power-system flexibility.
例如同一房屋或街道的邻居可以分享本地产电。: For example, neighbours in a building or street can share local generation.
影响自发电住户、邻里合作及参与的私法机构。: Relevant to households generating power, neighbourhood groups and participating organisations.
不代表免除计量、网络接入或合同要求；月度官方综述未列出各项费用细则。: Metering, grid access and contractual requirements still need checking; the monthly overview does not specify every charge.

旧标签可只写欧盟与非欧盟蜂蜜混合，无法看出各国产量比例。: Earlier labels could state only an EU/non-EU blend without country shares.
新标签列明原产国家及百分比，使消费者能比较来源。: New labels list origin countries and percentages, allowing consumers to compare sources.

截止日前已灌装产品仍可售完；不能仅凭旧标签断言存货违法。: Products packed before the cutoff may be sold through; an old label alone does not prove non-compliance.

影响领取德国法定养老金的人，可核对养老金调整通知。: Statutory pension recipients can check their adjustment notice.
标准示例不是人人同额增加；税费及其他个人扣款后的到账变化可能不同。: The standard example is not a flat increase for everyone; taxes and individual deductions can change the net amount.

适用护理机构应按岗位和资格核对工资；更高的合同或集体协议权利继续保留。: Covered providers should check roles and qualifications; higher contractual or collective entitlements remain.
不是所有私人家庭照护都适用；未纳入护理最低工资的情形适用一般最低工资。: Not all care in private households is covered; the general minimum wage applies outside the care-specific scope.

上限随后每半年降750欧元；7月20日之前已获承诺的申请不受影响。奖励百分比不等: The ceiling subsequently falls by €750 each half-year; commitments before 20 July remain unaffected. Bonus rates are not the total grant rate.

独居者在1/1bis、2、3区每月分别减35.99、31.58、29.57欧元，: Single residents receive €35.99, €31.58 or €29.57 monthly in zones 1/1bis, 2 or 3; other households use size-based amounts.

限符合条件的社会住房，不包括集体宿舍式住房及海外地区；领取APL不是必要条件。: Limited to qualifying social housing, excluding residential hostels and overseas areas; receiving APL is not required.

涉及保险、贷款、储蓄等远程服务客户与提供者。: Relevant to customers and providers of distance insurance, loans and savings products.

官方将其列为防止调查前资金转移的新权限。: The government describes it as a new power to prevent funds moving before assessment.
FIU可要求银行等机构最多五个工作日不执行交易，以判断是否涉及洗钱或恐怖融资。: FIU can request banks and other institutions to hold a transaction for up to five working days while assessing money laundering or terrorist financing.

未缴交通罚款者在首次加收前收到提醒，以便付款或及时安排分期。: People with unpaid traffic fines receive a reminder before the first increase to pay or arrange instalments.
帮助忘记付款者避免进一步加收。: Aims to help people who forgot to pay avoid additional charges.
试点至少一年半后评估；罚款及后续加收未被取消。: The pilot lasts at least 18 months before evaluation; fines and later increases remain.

部分OM岗位此前已有该要求，本次扩大岗位范围。: Some prosecution roles were already covered; the change expands coverage.
新增管理、政策、运营、研究、项目岗位以及培训生和实习生等，申请时必须查询警方资料: Additional management, policy, operations, research and project roles, trainees and interns require police-data checks.
应聘者及招聘部门需按岗位适用的诚信审查办理。: Applicants and recruiters should apply the role-specific integrity screening.

荷兰：协会及基金会超额董事票权过渡期结束: Netherlands: transition for dominant board voting rights ends
7月1日，WBTR五年过渡期结束。: The five-year WBTR transition ends on 1 July.
2021年法律为旧章程的不对等票权安排保留五年调整期。: The 2021 law gave legacy voting clauses five years to adjust.
单名董事不得拥有超过其余董事总和的票数，违反这一限制的旧条款自动失效。: One board member cannot hold more votes than all others combined; conflicting legacy clauses automatically lapse.
协会和基金会应检查章程及表决安排。: Associations and foundations should check their statutes and voting arrangements.
这是旧法过渡到期，不代表所有不等额票权都被禁止；关键是不得超过其余成员合计。: This is an existing law’s transition deadline; unequal weighting is not universally banned, but one member cannot outweigh all others combined.

当事人可选择电子形式，并获得与纸质提单相同的法律后果。: Parties may choose electronic form with the same legal effects as paper.
涉及发货人、船东、运输商、银行和保险商的海运贸易流程。: Relevant to shippers, shipowners, carriers, banks and insurers in maritime trade.
电子形式是可选，不意味着纸质提单失效或所有运输单证强制数字化。: Electronic form is optional; paper remains valid and not every transport document must become digital.

最高提高至八年，相应预备行为也可处罚，包括持有及传播3D打印武器制作蓝图。: The maximum rises to eight years, bringing relevant preparations, including possession and distribution of 3D-weapon blueprints, within criminal scope.
影响武器制造、交易及相关制作资料的持有传播行为。: Relevant to manufacture, trade and associated construction instructions.
八年是法定最高刑，不是每个案件自动判处的固定刑期。: Eight years is the statutory maximum, not an automatic sentence in every case.

适用于西班牙农业、工业和服务业雇员，不按性别或年龄区分；雇主须将低于法定年度最低: Applies to employees in agriculture, industry and services in Spain regardless of sex or age. Employers must raise wages below the statutory annual floor.

德国：内阁拟提高2027年社保缴费上限: Germany: Cabinet approves higher social insurance contribution ceilings for 2027
内阁已通过，仍待联邦参议院同意: Approved by the Cabinet; Bundesrat consent remains pending
10月7日内阁通过2027年调整条例。医保年度缴费上限拟升至76,500欧元，养: On 7 October, the Cabinet approved the 2027 regulation. Annual contribution ceilings would rise to EUR 76,500 for health insurance and EUR 106,200 for pension and unemployment insurance. Bundesrat consent is still required.
2026年医保年度缴费上限为69,750欧元；一般养老及失业保险为101,400: In 2026, the annual ceilings are EUR 69,750 for health insurance and EUR 101,400 for general pension and unemployment insurance.
拟从2027年起分别提高至76,500欧元和106,200欧元。医保一般强制参保: From 2027, the ceilings would increase to EUR 76,500 and EUR 106,200 respectively. The general annual earnings threshold for mandatory health insurance would rise to EUR 84,150; this is distinct from the contribution ceiling.
收入超过现行缴费上限的法定社会保险参保者及其雇主。: People covered by statutory social insurance with earnings above the existing contribution ceilings, and their employers.
这是缴费基数上限调整，不等于所有人费率统一提高。年薪8万欧元低于养老和失业保险新: This changes contribution ceilings, not contribution rates for everyone. Annual pay of EUR 80,000 is below both the old and new pension and unemployment ceilings, so raising those ceilings does not increase these contributions. Actual costs depend on insurance, rates and individual circumstances; this does not establish a flat EUR 120 monthly loss in take-home pay.
计划实施日期；须先核实联邦参议院同意及正式公布: Planned start; verify Bundesrat consent and formal publication first
2026年10月7日是内阁决定日。2027年1月1日是拟实施日期，未记为已确认生: 7 October 2026 is the Cabinet decision date. 1 January 2027 is the intended start, not a confirmed commencement date.
支持拟议上限、内阁日期及仍需联邦参议院同意。: Supports the proposed ceilings, Cabinet date and outstanding Bundesrat consent.
用于核对2026年缴费上限。: Used to check the 2026 contribution ceilings.
已核读劳动部原文并补充政策解读；内阁通过不等于立法程序完成。: The BMAS announcement has been reviewed and explained; Cabinet approval does not complete the legislative process.
定向补录10月7日社保上限公告；未完成该渠道近期分页和全部公告核查，保留覆盖缺口: Targeted addition of the 7 October contribution-ceiling announcement; recent index pages and all announcements on this channel have not been exhaustively checked. Coverage gaps remain.
德国：2027年拟让高收入者按更多工资缴社保: Germany: More of higher earners’ pay would count towards social insurance from 2027
以税前年薪8万欧元为例：2026年医保最多按其中69,750欧元计算保费；新方案: For example, on annual gross pay of EUR 80,000, health insurance contributions in 2026 are calculated on at most EUR 69,750. The proposal would raise that amount to EUR 76,500 from 2027. Contributions would rise even if pay and contribution rates stayed unchanged. The Cabinet has approved the proposal; Bundesrat consent is still pending.
2026年：法定医保最多按每年69,750欧元的税前收入计算保费，超过的部分不再: In 2026, statutory health insurance contributions are calculated on at most EUR 69,750 of annual gross income; income above that amount attracts no further health insurance contributions. General pension and unemployment insurance have a separate limit of EUR 101,400 in annual gross income.
拟从2027年起：医保最多按每年76,500欧元的税前收入计算保费；一般养老、失: From 2027, health insurance contributions would be calculated on at most EUR 76,500 of annual gross income, and general pension and unemployment contributions on at most EUR 106,200. These amounts are the income used to calculate contributions, not the contributions payable.
主要影响税前年收入超过69,750欧元的法定医保参保者，以及超过101,400欧: This mainly affects statutory health insurance members with annual gross income above EUR 69,750, and general pension and unemployment insurance members earning above EUR 101,400, together with their employers. Each type of insurance is calculated separately.
年薪8万欧元的例子中，新增6,750欧元工资需要计缴医保费，不是每年多交6,75: In the EUR 80,000 salary example, an additional EUR 6,750 of pay would count towards health insurance; this does not mean paying EUR 6,750 more in annual contributions. The applicable contribution rates must be applied to that pay. EUR 80,000 remains below both the old and new pension and unemployment income limits, so raising those limits does not increase those contributions. Changes in take-home pay depend on individual circumstances and are not a flat EUR 120 per month.
另一个数字：何时必须参加法定医保: A separate threshold: mandatory statutory health insurance
一般雇员必须参加法定医保的税前年收入门槛拟升至84,150欧元。这个数字用于判断: The general annual gross earnings threshold for mandatory statutory health insurance would rise to EUR 84,150. It determines whether coverage is compulsory, and is distinct from the EUR 76,500 income limit used to calculate contributions. Eligibility conditions and exceptions still apply.
核对哪些收入要计缴保费，以及内阁决定和后续程序。: Verifies the income counted towards contributions, the Cabinet decision and remaining procedural steps.
核对2026年最多按多少税前收入计算保费。: Verifies the maximum gross income used to calculate contributions in 2026.
说明金额是计费收入，不是保费: Clarification: Income used to calculate contributions, not premiums
改用年薪8万欧元的例子解释计算方式；政策金额和待决状态不变。: Explains the calculation using annual pay of EUR 80,000; policy amounts and pending status are unchanged.

现行规则仍有效：个人买入并仅持有比特币等，超过一年后出售，收益通常不按私人出售交: Current rules remain in force: private investors who buy and simply hold Bitcoin or comparable assets generally owe no income tax on private-sale gains after more than one year. Business assets, staking or lending income and special tokens require separate treatment.
绿党法案21/5752已于2026年10月8日被否决。它拟对2026年1月1日起: Green bill 21/5752 was rejected on 8 October 2026. It proposed removing the one-year relief for crypto assets acquired from 1 January 2026 and taxing sale gains at personal income-tax rates; earlier holdings retained the old rules.
财政部9月30日部门草案仍未通过：拟对2027年1月1日起取得的比特币、以太币等: The BMF ministerial draft of 30 September is not enacted. Sale gains on covered assets such as Bitcoin and Ether acquired from 1 January 2027 would be capital income regardless of holding period, generally taxed at 25% plus applicable surcharges. Earlier holdings would generally retain the old rules.
财政部确认草案进入部际协调，计划提交内阁；尚不能写成内阁已通过或已经生效。SPD: BMF confirms interministerial coordination and a planned cabinet consideration, not cabinet approval or a law in force. The welcoming SPD speech establishes that position, not coalition-wide agreement on every provision or certain passage.
假设2026年6月买入比特币，仅持有至2027年7月出售：按现行法通常可享受超过: Example: buy Bitcoin in June 2026, simply hold it and sell in July 2027. Current law generally exempts the gain after more than one year. The rejected Green bill would have covered that 2026 holding; the BMF draft would generally preserve it. A 2027 purchase sold after more than one year in 2028 would lose the relief only if the BMF draft became law unchanged.
财政部现稿并非所有代币一律适用；NFT、证券型代币及部分电子货币代币有其他规则。: The BMF draft does not cover all tokens alike; NFTs, security tokens and certain e-money tokens follow other rules. New assets received from lending or staking old holdings from 2027 may be covered. The 25% figure is the general capital-income rate, not a blanket tax on gross sale proceeds or a guaranteed individual final liability. Proposed taxation from 2027 and withholding from 2028 are not enacted dates.

核对现行一年期限；不从尚未通过的草案推断现行法已变。: Checks the current one-year period; drafts do not change current law.

Following this update, and after the withdrawal of PONTIS from the list, the number of projects holding CB RES status now stands at 15. The newly added projects are: WIND : this cross-border project between Ukraine and Romania will deploy large-scale onshore wind energy technology near Poltavska, with a planned installed capacity of 650 MW. The project is expected to generate approximately 2TWh of electricity annually. DEPLOY : this joint project in Poland and Germany aims to unlock Poland’s renewable energy potential to the benefits of consumers across the border. It plans to deploy an integrated power plant in Guben (Poland) , including a wind farm and photovoltaic installations with a combined capacity of 180 MW,. The electricity will be converted in heat made available to industrial offtakers in Gubin (Germany), and will also help decarbonise district heating in Guben. ZEGA-LINNK : this project builds on the shared district heating network supplying Braunau (Austria) and Simbach (Germany), which has been in place since 2001–2003 and has expanded continuously since then. A geothermal borehole in Simbach currently provides the base load, while natural gas boilers cover peak demand. To reduce fossil fuel-based peak load generation, the project plans to install a 5 MW heat pump in Simbach and develop a new 12–15 MW geothermal borehole in Braunau. Through the cross-border district heating network, surplus geothermal heat from Germany is delivered to Austria, while renewable heat generated in both countries provides mutual redundancy, reducing the need for large peak-load and backup systems. Other projects in the CB RES list ELWIND : a hybrid offshore wind park between Estonia and Latvia. United Heat : a cross-border district heating grid based on RES between Germany and Poland. CICERONE : a project to produce renewable electricity in Spain and Germany for conversion, transport and use of green hydrogen in the Netherlands and Germany. SLOWP

养猪和家禽场：新排放规则按规模分期落实: Pig and poultry farms: new emission rules phased in by capacity
受工业排放指令覆盖的养猪和家禽场，将按新统一运营条件控制氨排放、氮磷排泄并进行监: Pig and poultry farms covered by the Industrial Emissions Directive will control ammonia emissions and nitrogen/phosphorus excretion and carry out monitoring under uniform operating conditions. Capacity-based implementation deadlines fall in 2030, 2031 and 2032.
原有工业排放和养殖场规则已经存在。2024年修订指令扩展了部分养殖场的覆盖范围；: Industrial and livestock emission rules already exist. The 2024 amending directive expanded coverage to some additional farms; this decision specifies uniform operating conditions. Existing requirements continue during the transition.
实施决定第4条规定：容量至少600个牲畜单位的受覆盖设施，最迟于2030年10月: Article 4 sets deadlines of 8 October 2030 for covered installations with at least 600 livestock units, 8 October 2031 for those with at least 400 but fewer than 600, and 8 October 2032 for other installations covered by Annex Ia.
受覆盖养殖场需要按饲养类别检查饲料、圈舍、粪污处理和监测安排。牲畜单位是不同动物: Covered farms need to check feed, housing, manure handling and monitoring requirements for their animal categories. Livestock units measure capacity using animal-specific conversion factors, rather than a headcount; an installation at 600 livestock units falls under the first deadline.
不是所有农场都纳入，具体范围按指令附件Ia及例外确定；不能把600或400个牲畜: Not all farms are covered: Annex Ia and its exceptions determine scope. The 600 and 400 livestock-unit thresholds are implementation bands, not the minimum thresholds for all coverage. Member States may validate other techniques providing equivalent protection, with proportionate requirements for certain existing installations. National implementation has not been checked country by country.
委员会已于2026年10月8日作出实施决定；实际适用按规模分期。: The Commission adopted the implementing decision on 8 October 2026; application is phased by capacity.

生命科学数据维护：拟投入6500万欧元: Life-science data maintenance: EUR 65 million earmarked
委员会为基因、蛋白质和生命科学文献等公共数据资源预留6500万欧元，帮助维持服务: The Commission has earmarked EUR 65 million for public resources covering genes, proteins and life-science literature to sustain services and open access. Grants remain subject to Horizon Europe evaluation procedures.
这些科研数据资源依赖分散、短期的资助，长期维护和服务连续性面临压力。: These research-data resources depend on fragmented, short-term funding, creating pressure on long-term maintenance and service continuity.
拟安排 GENCODE 1900万欧元、UniProt 3000万欧元、Euro: The earmarks are EUR 19 million for GENCODE, EUR 30 million for UniProt and EUR 8 million for Europe PMC, plus EUR 8 million through an open competitive call for other critical resources. EUR 65 million is the total package, not an annual individual benefit.
使用基因注释、蛋白质数据库和文献关联数据的研究人员及生物技术企业，主要受益于数据: Researchers and biotechnology businesses using gene annotations, protein databases and linked literature principally benefit from continued curation and reliable access. Other data-service organisations can monitor the separate competitive call and its conditions.
预留预算不等于赠款已签约或已拨付；不能据此认定个人可以领取6500万欧元或其中任: Earmarking is not a signed grant or a disbursement, and it does not entitle individuals to the package or a fixed share. The announcement provides no common application deadline; specific call and grant conditions govern subsequent steps.
欧洲维修在线平台接口及国家平台期限: European repair interface and national-platform deadline
欧盟要求成员国落实列明产品的制造商维修义务；对2026年7月31日起签订的受适用: EU rules require Member States to implement manufacturer repair duties for listed products. For covered sales contracts concluded from 31 July 2026, choosing repair within the legal guarantee generally extends the seller’s liability period once by 12 months.
例如，2026年8月1日签订的受覆盖商品买卖合同，可依落实后的规则考虑维修带来的: For example, a covered sales contract concluded on 1 August 2026 can benefit from the one-time 12-month extension under the implemented rules. A contract concluded on 1 July 2026 is outside this directive’s Article 16 amendment; existing national protections must still be checked.
制造商维修义务限于附件II列明产品及可维修要求；无法维修时有例外，担保范围外的制: Manufacturer duties apply only to Annex II products and the relevant reparability requirements, with an exception where repair is impossible; manufacturer repairs outside the guarantee may carry a reasonable charge. Seller repairs to remedy non-conformity within the guarantee must be free. Member States may retain longer liability periods; systems without a fixed liability period may use arrangements providing at least equivalent three-year protection under the directive. National transposition and enforcement have not been checked country by country.
成员国须自2026年7月31日起适用转化措施；第16条对销售担保规则的修订不适用: Member States must apply transposing measures from 31 July 2026. Article 16’s amendments to sales-guarantee rules do not apply to contracts concluded before that date. The common repair-platform interface and relevant national platforms have a deadline of 31 July 2027. The 7 October 2026 corrigendum only corrects an entry number in Article 18.

2027所得税改革草案：免税额与儿童金上调，25万欧元以上收入加税: 2027 income tax reform bill: higher allowances and child benefit, more tax above EUR 250,000
截至10月9日：政府草案已在联邦议院一读并转交委员会，10月16日参议院作第一轮: As of 9 October: the government bill has had its Bundestag first reading and committee referral, and the Bundesrat gives its first-round opinion on 16 October; no final parliamentary vote date is known. 1 January 2027 is the proposed commencement, not a confirmed adoption date.
联邦政府2027年所得税改革法案仍在议会审议，尚未通过。拟提高基本免税额、儿童金: The federal government's 2027 income tax reform bill is still before parliament and has not been adopted. It would raise the basic allowance, child benefit, child allowance and employee lump-sum deduction; apply 45% earlier from EUR 250,000 of taxable income and add 47% above EUR 280,000; and cut the tradesperson-service credit while raising the mini-job flat tax. The Bundesrat gives its first-round opinion on 16 October.
现行规则（2026年，单身者税率表）：应税收入12,348欧元以下不征所得税；从: Current rules (2026, single-person tax schedule): no income tax on taxable income up to EUR 12,348; a 42% marginal rate from EUR 69,879 and 45% from EUR 277,826. Child benefit is EUR 259 a month; the child allowance is EUR 3,414 per parent (EUR 6,828 per child in total); the employee lump-sum deduction for work expenses is EUR 1,230 a year; 20% of tradesperson-service costs can be credited against tax, up to EUR 1,200 a year; the mini-job flat tax is 2%.
政府草案拟自2027年起：基本免税额12,564欧元，42%从70,601欧元起: From 2027 the government bill proposes: a EUR 12,564 basic allowance, 42% from EUR 70,601, 45% brought forward to EUR 250,000, and a new 47% above EUR 280,000; the allowance would rise again to EUR 12,900 in 2028. Child benefit would be EUR 267 in 2027 and EUR 272 in 2028; the child allowance per parent EUR 3,564 in 2027 and EUR 3,654 in 2028. The employee lump-sum deduction would be EUR 1,430; the tradesperson-service credit would fall to 15%, up to EUR 900; the mini-job flat tax would rise to 5%; and the hourly-pay cap for tax-free Sunday and holiday premiums would rise from EUR 50 to EUR 75 (night work stays at EUR 50).
假设示例（单身、只算按税率表计算的所得税，不含团结附加税、教会税和社保；“应税收: Hypothetical example (single person, income tax from the schedule only, excluding solidarity surcharge, church tax and social insurance; “taxable income” is the amount after deductions, not gross pay): on EUR 50,000 of taxable income, tax is EUR 10,548 under the 2026 schedule and EUR 10,482 under the proposed 2027 schedule, EUR 66 less; at EUR 300,000 it rises from EUR 115,529 to EUR 116,658, EUR 1,129 more. Under the bill, 2027 tax would exceed 2026 tax only from roughly EUR 254,000 of taxable income. If an employee's actual work expenses are below EUR 1,430, the EUR 200 higher lump sum also lowers taxable income, saving roughly another EUR 70 around EUR 50,000. Joint spousal assessment halves the couple's combined income, applies the schedule and doubles the result, so the amount thresholds effectively double.
这是政府法案，不是现行法：须经联邦议院通过，并须联邦参议院同意；条文和数额仍可能: This is a government bill, not current law: it needs Bundestag adoption and Bundesrat consent, and its provisions and amounts may still change. On 16 October the Bundesrat gives only a first-round opinion, not a final vote. The Bundesrat finance committee also recommends ending the 10-year exemption for sales of property not used as one's own home and examining a reform of joint spousal taxation; neither is in the government bill nor yet adopted by the Bundesrat. Child benefit and allowance amounts rest on the expected results of the 16th subsistence-minimum report due this autumn. The example is not anyone's final tax bill.

An “item” means goods in one consignment sharing the same tariff classification, description (and origin); one declaration line counts once regardless of quantity. It is published and enters into force only if Parliament and the Council do not object, with a scrutiny period of generally two months; the guidance's expected 1 November start implies scrutiny ending early, otherwise it slips. 免税上限原为每人每年300欧元，2026年先提高到600欧元。燃油补贴原则上不能: The ceiling was originally EUR 300 per employee per year and was first raised to EUR 600 for 2026. In principle the fuel allowance could not be combined with the employer's compulsory contribution to public transport passes.
拟议：2026年发放的燃油补贴每人每年最多1,000欧元免缴社保费和所得税（电动: Proposed: fuel allowances paid in 2026 are free of social contributions and income tax up to EUR 1,000 per employee per year (EUR 600 for charging electric, plug-in hybrid or hydrogen vehicles and similar costs); in 2026 they can be combined with the public transport pass contribution and paid even where home or work is served by public transport.
用私家车上下班、雇主愿意发放燃油补贴的雇员。补贴是自愿的，员工无权要求。假设示例: Employees who drive their own car to work and whose employer chooses to pay a fuel allowance. The allowance is voluntary; employees cannot demand it. 10月1日起，收入属于国家住房署（Anah）标准“低收入”或“很低收入”的独栋房: From 1 October, owners of detached houses whose incomes are "low" or "very low" under the national housing agency (Anah) criteria can apply through six selected consortia for an integrated package replacing gas or oil heating with a heat pump. 用燃气或燃油取暖、拥有独栋住宅、收入不超过Anah低收入线的家庭。例如3口之家（: Households heating with gas or oil who own a detached house and whose income is within Anah's low-income limits; for example, a three-person household outside Île-de-France and overseas with a reference tax income of at most EUR 39,148. 法国2027年财政法案草案：所得税档位上调2.1%、退休金10%扣除拟设3,00: France's draft 2027 finance bill: income tax brackets up 2.1%, a proposed EUR 3,000 cap on the 10% pension deduction and more; still before the National Assembly
10月1日提交国民议会，交财政委员会审议；国防委员会10月7日提交意见（第327: Tabled in the National Assembly on 1 October and referred to the finance committee; the defence committee gave its opinion on 7 October (No. 3279) and the finance committee report is listed as No. 3291. No vote has taken place, and the content may change.
政府10月1日提交的2027年预算草案中，与家庭直接相关的主要条款：所得税各档门: The main household measures in the government's draft 2027 budget, tabled on 1 October: income tax bracket thresholds rise by 2.1%; the 10% pension deduction gets a separate EUR 3,000 cap; work-accident sick pay loses its partial tax exemption and half of long-term-condition (ALD) sick pay becomes taxable; the income tax exemption for termination payments is capped at one annual social-security ceiling; the housing parameters of housing benefit (APL) and the activity bonus are not uprated in 2027; and students whose parents have higher incomes must choose between APL and their parents' tax advantages. All are proposals and have not passed.
现行（2025年收入适用）：所得税档位门槛11,600 / 29,579 / 8: Current law (applied to 2025 income): bracket thresholds EUR 11,600 / 29,579 / 84,577 / 181,917; the 10% pension deduction is capped at EUR 4,439 per household; work-accident sick pay is partly tax-exempt; APL housing parameters are adjusted each 1 October to the rent index and the activity bonus is uprated each year; students' APL ignores parental income.
草案：档位门槛改为11,844 / 30,200 / 86,353 / 185,: Proposed: bracket thresholds become EUR 11,844 / 30,200 / 86,353 / 185,737 (for 2026 income declared in 2027); within the pension deduction, pensions count for at most EUR 3,000; from 2027 work-accident sick pay becomes fully taxable and 50% of ALD sick pay taxable; the income tax exemption for termination payments is capped at one annual social-security ceiling (EUR 48,060 in 2026); APL housing parameters and the activity bonus are not uprated in 2027 (the government may restore this by decree); from 1 September 2027 students counted in a parental tax household whose income per share exceeds the top of the second bracket, or for whom parents deduct maintenance payments, cannot receive APL.
几乎所有纳税家庭（档位上调）；领退休金的家庭；工伤或长期病停工者；领APL和就业: Almost all taxpaying households (bracket indexation); households with pension income; people off work after a work accident or with a long-term condition; recipients of APL and the activity bonus; students whose parents have higher incomes. Hypothetical example (single person, tax schedule only, ignoring reductions and household shares): with 2026 taxable income of EUR 30,000, under the current thresholds the EUR 421 above EUR 29,579 is taxed at 30%; if the bill passes, all EUR 30,000 is below the new EUR 30,200 threshold, so that EUR 421 is taxed at 11%, about EUR 80 less tax. Another example: a retired couple with EUR 60,000 of pensions has a 10% deduction of EUR 6,000; currently at most EUR 4,439 can be deducted, under the bill at most EUR 3,000, so taxable income rises by EUR 1,439.
这是政府草案，议会可修改或否决，所列数字均为草案文本。按第33条，档位上调和退休: This is a government bill; Parliament may amend or reject it, and all figures are those of the bill. Under Article 33 the bracket indexation and pension cap apply to income tax on 2026 income; the withholding rate tables and the CSG change apply from 1 January 2027. Other provisions (a temporary gift-tax relief, life insurance, housing tax measures, business taxes and more) are only summarised or not explained individually. The fuel allowance rise to EUR 1,000 is also in Article 2 and has its own explanation. The draft 2027 social security financing bill (No. 3211) contains pension uprating and other measures, explained separately.
各档门槛按2026年预测通胀2.1%上调：11,600→11,844、29,57: Bracket thresholds rise by the 2.1% forecast inflation for 2026: 11,600→11,844, 29,579→30,200, 84,577→86,353, 181,917→185,737 euros; default withholding tables are adjusted accordingly.
现行每户上限4,439欧元之内，退休金部分最多3,000欧元；赡养费和残疾抚恤金: Within the current EUR 4,439 household cap, retirement pensions count for at most EUR 3,000; the deduction for maintenance and invalidity pensions is unchanged.
ALD病假津贴50%计税；工伤津贴取消部分免税；疾病和工伤津贴的较低CSG税率取: ALD sick pay 50% taxable; work-accident sick pay loses its partial exemption; the lower CSG rate on sickness and work-accident allowances ends (from 2027); the income tax exemption for termination payments is capped at one annual social-security ceiling.
2027年不作APL住房参数的年度调整和就业奖励金的年度上调，可由法令恢复；RS: In 2027 the annual adjustment of APL housing parameters and the annual uprating of the activity bonus are not applied, though a decree may restore them; minimum benefits such as RSA, AAH and ASPA are still uprated with inflation.
学生住房补助二选一（第78条）: Students: APL or parental tax advantage (Article 78)
自2027年9月1日起，若学生被计入人均参考收入超过第二档上限的父母税户，或父母: From 1 September 2027 a student counted in a parental tax household whose reference income per share exceeds the top of the second bracket, or for whom parents deduct maintenance, cannot receive APL; 2026 income is used in 2027.
2027年1月1日至6月30日，向18至50岁子孙（无子孙时为侄甥）赠与现金，每: From 1 January to 30 June 2027, cash gifts to children or grandchildren aged 18 to 50 (or nephews and nieces where there are none) are taxed at a flat 6% up to EUR 100,000 per donor and recipient; 5% if the recipient gives at least 1.1% to eligible charities.
除另有规定外，税收措施2027年1月1日生效；以年度结束为课税事实的税种（如所得: Unless stated otherwise, tax measures take effect on 1 January 2027; taxes triggered by the end of the year (such as income tax) apply from 31 December 2026, i.e. to 2026 income.

草案中与家庭直接相关的主要条款：2027年基本养老金只对每月养老金总额不超过1,: The main household measures in the bill: in 2027 basic pensions would rise by the statutory inflation coefficient only for people whose total pensions are at most EUR 1,260 a month; for higher amounts the rise would be set by decree and could be zero (with no decree, no rise); non-EU nationals would need one year of legal residence for some family benefits; the exemption of termination payments from social contributions and CSG would be capped at one annual social-security ceiling; the social-contribution advantages of the value-sharing bonus would be made permanent, with full exemption for such bonuses paid in 2027 by companies with fewer than 50 employees. 现行：基本养老金每年1月1日按过去12个月通胀全额上调；合法居留的非欧盟国籍者按: Current law: basic pensions rise each 1 January by the past 12 months' inflation; non-EU nationals with legal residence receive family benefits on ordinary terms without a minimum residence period; termination payments have several different social-contribution exemption caps; the social-contribution advantages of the value-sharing bonus were due to end on 31 December 2026.

Family benefits: non-EU nationals would need one year of legal residence (except refugees, beneficiaries of subsidiary protection, stateless people and those entitled to equal treatment under EU law or international agreements; benefits linked to disability, serious illness or a child's death are unaffected), applying to rights opened from a date set by decree and at the latest 1 July 2027.
基本养老金领取者（尤其每月养老金合计超过1,260欧元者）；新到法国的非欧盟国籍: Recipients of basic pensions (especially those with more than EUR 1,260 a month in total); non-EU families newly arrived in France; employees receiving large termination payments; companies paying value-sharing bonuses and their staff. Hypothetical example: a retiree with EUR 1,800 a month in total pensions would stay at EUR 1,800 from January 2027 if the bill passes and no decree grants a rise; someone with EUR 1,200 a month would receive the full statutory rise.
草案仍可修改。第37条的范围：政府立法理由称持居民卡或持允许工作证件者也不受1年: The bill may still change. 学生助学金（BAföG）改革草案：在外居住补贴拟升至440欧元，基本需求分两步升: Student aid (BAföG) reform bill: housing allowance for students living away from home to rise to EUR 440, basic rate to EUR 563 in two steps
联邦政府拟修改学生助学金（BAföG）：不住父母家的大学生，住房补贴拟自2027: The federal government wants to change student aid (BAföG). For university students not living with their parents, the housing allowance would rise from EUR 380 to EUR 440 a month from 1 April 2027. The basic rate for university students would rise from EUR 475 to EUR 503 (winter semester 2027/28) and EUR 563 (1 April 2029). For students living with their parents, the housing allowance would fall from EUR 59 to EUR 41 and end in 2029. Applications would in principle be made only online via “BAföG Digital”. The bill has not been passed.
现行规则：大学生每月基本需求额475欧元；不住父母家另加住房补贴380欧元（合计: Current rules: the monthly basic rate for university students is EUR 475. Students not living with their parents receive an extra EUR 380 for housing (EUR 855 in total); those living with their parents receive EUR 59 (EUR 534 in total). Health and long-term care insurance supplements are paid on top. The income allowances (amounts of parents’ and own income that are not counted) are not adjusted automatically every year. Paper forms can be used, and a proof of study progress is required from the fifth semester.
草案拟：2027年4月1日起，在外居住住房补贴440欧元，医疗保险补贴从102欧: The bill proposes: from 1 April 2027, a housing allowance of EUR 440 for students living away from home and a health insurance supplement rising from EUR 102 to EUR 121; from the 2027/28 academic year (the provisions take effect on 1 August 2027), a basic rate of EUR 503 and a housing allowance of EUR 41 for students living with their parents; from 1 April 2029, a basic rate of EUR 563 and no housing allowance for students living with their parents. Income allowances would rise by 1.5% a year from the 2028/29 academic year. Applications would in principle be made only via “BAföG Digital” (hardship cases excepted), and the fifth-semester progress proof would be dropped. Vocational training aid (Berufsausbildungsbeihilfe) and training allowance would be raised by similar amounts.
假设示例（大学生，按最高额计算，即父母和本人收入不导致扣减，不含医疗和护理保险补: Hypothetical example (university student at the maximum rate, i.e. no deduction for parents’ or own income; insurance supplements excluded): living away from home, EUR 855 a month now; EUR 915 from April 2027, EUR 943 from the 2027/28 winter semester and EUR 1,003 from April 2029. Living with parents, EUR 534 now; EUR 544 from the 2027/28 semester (503 + 41) and EUR 563 from April 2029. Actual amounts depend on parents’ and own income, and many students do not receive the maximum.
这是政府法案，不是现行法：须经联邦议院通过，联邦参议院再审议；数额和日期仍可能修: This is a government bill, not current law: the Bundestag must pass it and the Bundesrat then deals with it; amounts and dates can still change. In its opinion, the Bundesrat criticised that the housing allowance does not rise in winter semester 2026/27 as the coalition agreement said, that the second increase comes one semester later, and that the allowance for students living with parents is cut. The government rejected these demands in its reply. The example uses statutory rates only and does not show what any individual will receive.

进修晋升资助（“晋升BAföG”）改革草案：课程费资助上限拟升至18,000欧元: Upgrading-training aid (“Aufstiegs-BAföG”) reform bill: cap on funded course fees to rise to EUR 18,000
面向参加师傅、技术员、专业经济师等进修的人。政府拟自2027年8月1日起提高资助: For people taking upgrading courses such as master craftsperson, technician or business specialist qualifications. From 1 August 2027 the government would raise support: the total course and exam fees that can be funded would rise from EUR 15,000 to EUR 18,000, material costs for the master piece from EUR 2,000 to EUR 4,000, the share of the loan waived after passing the exam from 50% to 60%, and the childcare supplement for single parents from EUR 150 to EUR 160 per child per month. Employer contributions would no longer be deducted. The bill has not been passed.
现行规则：课程和考试费最多资助15,000欧元，其中一部分是补助、其余是复兴信贷: Current rules: course and exam fees are funded up to EUR 15,000, partly as a grant and partly as a low-interest KfW loan; material costs for the master piece up to EUR 2,000; after passing the exam, 50% of the fee loan is waived; single parents get a childcare supplement of EUR 150 per child per month; employer payments for the same course are deducted from the support.
草案拟：课程和考试费资助上限18,000欧元；材料费上限4,000欧元；考试通过: The bill proposes: a EUR 18,000 cap for course and exam fees; EUR 4,000 for material costs; 60% of the fee loan waived after passing; a EUR 160 childcare supplement; employer contributions no longer deducted. It also clarifies that courses preparing for university degrees are not covered by this aid.
假设示例：课程和考试费共16,000欧元。现行规则最多按15,000欧元资助，超: Hypothetical example: course and exam fees of EUR 16,000. Under current rules support is capped at EUR 15,000, so EUR 1,000 is paid personally; under the bill, all EUR 16,000 could be covered. After passing the exam, 10 percentage points more of the loan part would be waived. The exact grant/loan split follows the original text; this example does not calculate repayments.
这是政府法案，不是现行法。过渡规则：2027年8月1日前已开始、尚未结束的进修，: This is a government bill, not current law. Transition: courses that started before 1 August 2027 and are not finished stay under the old rules in principle, but the new childcare supplement and material costs incurred after 1 August apply; waiver applications received by 31 July 2027 still get 50%.

住房补贴（Wohngeld）改革草案：2027年不再按物价上调，取暖部分减半: Housing benefit (Wohngeld) reform bill: no inflation update in 2027, heating component halved
领取住房补贴（Wohngeld）的家庭需要关注。政府拟自2027年1月1日起：取: Households receiving housing benefit (Wohngeld) should take note. From 1 January 2027 the government would: cancel the inflation and rent update planned for 2027; halve the “permanent heating component” counted in the calculation (from EUR 96 to EUR 48 a month for a single person); and change a parameter of the formula. The government estimates about 381,000 households would no longer qualify, about 143,000 of them moving to basic income support. Several simplifications are also planned, such as paying only into bank accounts. The bill has not been passed.
现行规则：住房补贴每两年按物价和租金自动上调，下次本应在2027年1月1日。计算: Current rules: housing benefit is updated for prices and rents every two years; the next update was due on 1 January 2027. In the calculation, a heating relief amount is added to the maximum rent that can be counted: EUR 110.40 a month for a single person (EUR 14.40 for carbon pricing plus a permanent heating component of EUR 96), EUR 142.60 for two people.
草案拟：2027年1月1日不进行上调；长期取暖费部分减半，单人户取暖减负额降至6: The bill proposes: no update on 1 January 2027; the permanent heating component halved, so the heating relief falls to EUR 62.40 for a single person (14.40 + 48) and EUR 80.60 for two people (18.60 + 62); a higher formula parameter “c”, which lowers payments. When assessing income, work expenses would be deducted only at the income-tax flat rate, not at higher actual amounts; payment only into a bank account; the allowance for disability or care needs could be proven with the care grade alone.

生物质条例修订：落实欧盟可再生能源指令，木材燃烧受更多限制: Biomass regulation amendment: implementing the EU renewables directive, more limits on burning wood
条例草案落实欧盟可再生能源指令（RED III），规定哪些生物质发电可获补贴，强: The draft regulation implements the EU renewables directive (RED III), setting which biomass power can receive support and strengthening the “cascade” principle: wood should first be used in construction, panels and paper, and burned only at the end. Experts were divided.
现行条例按旧欧盟规则。: The current regulation follows older EU rules.
按RED III更新可再生发电所用生物质的要求。: Updates requirements for biomass used in renewable power under RED III.
主要影响生物质电厂和地方供热；对家庭取暖用柴不直接规定。: Mainly affects biomass plants and local heating; it does not directly regulate household firewood.
这是条例草案，尚须联邦议院程序和公布。: This is a draft regulation still in parliamentary procedure and not yet published.

专家发表意见；听证不作决定。: Experts commented; the hearing decides nothing.
社会福利行政数字化路线图：目标是少交证明、全程网上办理: Roadmap for digital social administration: fewer proofs, fully online services
联邦劳动部和数字部参与的专家小组10月8日提交路线图，落实社会国家改革委员会关于: On 8 October an expert group with the labour and digital ministries presented a roadmap implementing the social-state reform commission’s recommendations on digital administration: linking separate online services into one system so people submit fewer proofs, handle social benefits online end to end where possible, and misuse becomes harder.
各项社会福利网上服务分散，常需重复提交证明。: Online social-benefit services are fragmented and proofs often have to be submitted repeatedly.
路线图提出分步建设联网系统的计划。: The roadmap sets out steps to build a connected system.
目前不改变任何申请规则；未来办理失业金、住房补贴等可能更简便。: No application rules change yet; claiming unemployment benefit, housing benefit and the like may become simpler later.
只是规划，没有时间表承诺具体服务何时上线。: Only a plan; no commitment on when specific services go live.

“零毁林”产品法草案：咖啡、可可、大豆、木材等须证明非毁林来源: Deforestation-free products bill: coffee, cocoa, soy, wood and more must come from non-deforested land
按欧盟零毁林规定，牛、可可、咖啡、油棕、橡胶、大豆和木材及其制品，只有产自202: Under the EU deforestation rules, cattle, cocoa, coffee, oil palm, rubber, soy and wood and products made from them may only be marketed in the EU if produced on land not deforested after 31 December 2020. The German bill requires companies placing them on the market in Germany to carry out due diligence and file statements; authorities would check up to 9% of traders in products from “high-risk countries” each year, with penalties for violations. The bill has not been passed.
欧盟规定已直接适用，德国现行实施法需按新规定重订。: The EU rules apply directly; Germany’s current implementing law needs to be redone.
草案拟重新规定德国的执行、检查和处罚。: The bill would re-regulate enforcement, checks and penalties in Germany.
主要影响进口商、贸易商、林主和养殖户；消费者无需行动，部分商品成本可能受影响。: Mainly affects importers, traders, forest owners and livestock farmers; consumers need not act, though some product costs may be affected.

德国和比利时2024年4月29日签署条约，扩大两国警察和海关的跨境合作。批准须经: Germany and Belgium signed a treaty on 29 April 2024 expanding cross-border police and customs cooperation. Ratification needs Bundestag consent. No new obligations for residents.
两国按现有双边和多边协议合作。: Cooperation follows existing bilateral and multilateral agreements.
批准后合作范围扩大，细节可通过实施协议规定。: After ratification cooperation widens; details can be set in implementing agreements.
儿童和青少年福利结构改革草案：残疾儿童由青少年福利机构统一负责: Child and youth services reform bill: one office responsible for children with disabilities
有残疾儿童的家庭需要关注。政府拟让青少年福利机构成为残疾儿童及其家庭的统一主管，: Families with disabled children should take note. 残疾儿童的给付分散在青少年福利和社会救助（融合帮助）等不同机构。: Benefits for disabled children are split between youth welfare and social assistance (integration assistance) offices.
草案拟由青少年福利机构统一负责并引入教育助理。: The bill would make youth welfare offices responsible and introduce education assistance.
家庭今后可能只需联系一个机构；具体过渡和时间以最终法律为准。: Families may later deal with one office; transition and timing follow the final law.
移民管理使用人工智能法草案：可用申请人数据训练AI、比对公开网络信息: AI in migration administration bill: applicants’ data could train AI, and claims could be checked against public web data
办理庇护和居留的人需要关注。政府拟为移民机关使用人工智能提供法律依据：可用个人数: People dealing with asylum and residence procedures should take note. The government wants a legal basis for migration authorities to use AI: personal data could be used to develop, train and test AI systems; procedures and decision patterns could be analysed automatically; and where there is justified doubt about information in an application, it could be checked automatically against publicly available internet data. The bill has not been passed.
现行法律没有专门规定移民机关用个人数据训练AI或自动网络比对。: Current law has no specific basis for migration authorities to train AI on personal data or run automated web checks.
草案拟提供这些依据，并要求符合数据保护规定。: The bill would provide these bases, subject to data protection.
申请庇护或居留时提交的信息，可能被用于训练系统或与公开网络信息比对（仅在有合理怀: Information submitted in asylum or residence applications could be used to train systems or, where there is justified doubt, checked against public web data.
医疗数据与数字创新法草案：电子病历加入用药计划和疫苗提醒: Health data and digital innovation bill: medication plan and vaccination reminders in the electronic patient record
法定医保参保人需要关注。政府拟扩展电子病历（ePA）：医生和药房持续更新电子用药: People with statutory health insurance should take note. The government wants to extend the electronic patient record (ePA): doctors and pharmacies would keep a digital medication plan up to date, a digital vaccination record with reminders would be added, and insurers could add applications such as prevention reminders. It also implements the EU health data space regulation, so patient summaries, e-prescriptions, discharge letters, imaging and lab reports can be exchanged across borders in coming years. The bill has not been passed.
ePA已推出，但用药计划和疫苗记录功能有限。: The ePA exists but medication-plan and vaccination functions are limited.
草案拟增加上述功能并建立跨境交换。: The bill would add these functions and cross-border exchange.
参保人的电子病历可能包含更多信息；能否反对或限制访问以ePA现行规则和最终法律为: Patients’ ePA may hold more information; options to object or restrict access follow current ePA rules and the final law.
AfD法案：加强德国养老保险机构的独立性（反对党提案）: AfD bill on the independence of the German pension insurance (opposition proposal)
AfD认为政治干预了养老保险自治，尤其是用缴费支付不属于缴费对应的给付，提出加强: The AfD argues that politics interferes with pension insurance self-government, especially by paying non-contribution benefits from contributions, and proposes a bill to strengthen the independence of the German Pension Insurance (DRV), together with two motions on standard pension funds. This is an opposition proposal and not the government’s position.
现行养老保险由法律和自治机构共同管理。: Pension insurance is governed by law and self-governing bodies.
提案拟限制政治影响；具体内容以法案文本为准。: The proposal would limit political influence; details follow the bill text.
目前不影响任何人的养老金。: Affects no one’s pension at present.
这是反对党AfD提出的法案，不是现行法；执政党不支持的情况下通常难以通过。: This is a bill by the opposition AfD, not current law; without coalition support such bills rarely pass.
截至10月10日：AfD法案（21/8370）10月8日一读后转交劳动社会委员会: As of 10 October: the AfD bill (21/8370) was referred to the labour and social affairs committee after its first reading on 8 October; no vote yet.
科研人员定期合同改革草案：博士前首份合同至少3年，博士后至少2年: Academic fixed-term contract reform bill: first contracts at least 3 years before the PhD, 2 years after
在德国大学和研究机构工作的研究人员需要关注。政府拟修改《科学定期合同法》等：首次: Researchers at German universities and institutes should take note. The government wants to amend the Academic Fixed-Term Contract Act and related law, introducing for the first time minimum terms for first contracts: three years before the doctorate and two years after it, to improve working conditions while keeping flexibility for institutions. A Left motion to abolish the special fixed-term rules for academia was referred at the same time. The bill has not been passed.
现行法律没有首份合同的最短期限，常见短期合同。: Current law sets no minimum term for first contracts, and short contracts are common.
草案拟规定首份合同至少3年（博士前）或2年（博士后）。: The bill would require first contracts of at least 3 years (pre-doctoral) or 2 years (post-doctoral).
新签首份合同的研究人员可能获得更长期限；已有合同如何处理以过渡规则为准。: Researchers signing first contracts may get longer terms; existing contracts follow transitional rules.
AfD法案：限制社交网络删帖（反对党提案）: AfD bill to limit content removal on social networks (opposition proposal)
AfD提议修改《数字服务法》：占市场支配地位的社交网络只能按普通法律审查用户内容: The AfD proposes amending the Digital Services Act implementation law: dominant social networks could review user content only against general law, and platforms reviewing on other criteria would lose the liability exemptions of the EU Digital Services Act. This is an opposition proposal and not the government’s position.
平台按欧盟《数字服务法》和自身规则处理内容。: Platforms handle content under the EU DSA and their own rules.
提案拟限制平台按自身规则删帖。: The proposal would restrict removal based on platform rules.
目前不改变任何规则；部分内容可能与欧盟法冲突。: Changes nothing at present; parts may conflict with EU law.
截至10月10日：AfD法案（21/8369）10月8日一读后转交数字委员会，尚: As of 10 October: the AfD bill (21/8369) was referred to the digital committee after its first reading on 8 October; no vote yet.
高速公路公司融资改革草案：2028年起分得部分货车通行费，2027年起可自行借款: Autobahn company financing bill: share of truck tolls from 2028, own borrowing from 2027
政府拟让联邦高速公路公司不只靠联邦预算，而是由预算、通行费和私人资本三方面融资：: The government wants the federal Autobahn company to be financed not only from the federal budget but from three sources — budget, user charges and private capital: from 2028 part of truck toll revenue would go to the company, from 2027 it could borrow on the market, and public-private partnerships could be used more. The federation remains sole owner of the motorways. No charges for private cars are involved.
高速公路公司主要由联邦预算出资。: The company is funded mainly from the federal budget.
拟增加通行费收入和自行借款。: Toll revenue and own borrowing would be added.
对私家车司机没有新收费；目标是加快桥梁、隧道和路面修缮。: No new charges for car drivers; the aim is faster repair of bridges, tunnels and roads.
截至10月10日：内阁10月7日通过草案，尚须议会审议。: As of 10 October: the cabinet adopted the bill on 7 October; parliament still has to deal with it.
三方面融资、2027年借款、2028年通行费。: Three funding sources, borrowing from 2027, tolls from 2028.
TOP-1列表中未经讨论通过。: Adopted without debate in the TOP-1 list.
打击数字暴力法草案：色情深度伪造、偷拍和GPS跟踪拟入刑，受害者可要求平台提供施: Digital violence bill: sexual deepfakes, voyeur images and GPS stalking to be criminal; victims could obtain perpetrators’ data from platforms
内阁通过草案：未经同意制作或传播私密图像（包括色情深度伪造和“报复色情”）拟单独: The cabinet adopted a bill: making or sharing intimate images without consent (including sexual deepfakes and “revenge porn”) would become a specific offence, whether public or private, real or computer-generated; secretly filming nudity in public places such as saunas or naturist beaches, possessing rape videos and persistent GPS-tracker surveillance would also be criminal. With a court order, victims could obtain perpetrators’ names, addresses and other data from platforms and internet providers and have accounts blocked for a time.
现行刑法对深度伪造等存在空白，受害者难以查明匿名施害者。: Current criminal law has gaps for deepfakes and similar acts, and victims struggle to identify anonymous perpetrators.
新增罪名并设立数字暴力保护的民事请求权。: New offences and civil claims for protection against digital violence.
受害者可通过法院更容易追究施害者；分享他人私密图像的行为风险显著提高。: Victims could pursue perpetrators more easily through the courts; sharing others’ intimate images would carry much greater risk.
这是内阁草案，不是现行法；具体刑罚以最终法律为准。: This is a cabinet bill, not current law; penalties follow the final law.
家暴受害者家事诉讼保护草案：可选择法院以隐藏住址，有暴力时不强求和解: Domestic violence and family courts bill: choice of court to keep address secret, no push for agreement where there is violence
内阁通过草案：家暴受害的父母一方可选择受理法院，方便隐藏现住址；当事人之间存在暴: The cabinet adopted a bill: a parent affected by domestic violence could choose the competent court, making it easier to keep their current address secret; courts should not push parties to agree where there is a violent relationship; family judges would need knowledge of family law, child development psychology and domestic-violence dynamics; and professionals in protection and custody cases would have to cooperate faster. The bill also creates an electronic register of powers of attorney.
现行管辖规则可能暴露受害者住址，法院常尝试促成和解。: Current jurisdiction rules can reveal victims’ addresses, and courts often seek agreement.
草案拟改变这些程序规则。: The bill would change these procedural rules.
家暴受害者在离婚、抚养和接触权案件中可能得到更好保护。: Victims of domestic violence may be better protected in divorce, custody and contact cases.
德国批准欧盟—南方共同市场伙伴协定的法案: German ratification bill for the EU–Mercosur partnership agreement
欧盟与阿根廷、巴西、巴拉圭、乌拉圭2026年1月17日签署伙伴协定，其中贸易部分: The EU signed a partnership agreement with Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay on 17 January 2026; its trade part would gradually remove tariffs on more than 91% of EU exports to these countries over 15 years and, once in force, replace the interim trade agreement. As a “mixed agreement” it needs German parliamentary approval.
批准法拟同意协定。: The ratification law would approve the agreement.
对消费者影响间接（进口商品价格和种类）；农业团体关注竞争影响。: Indirect effects for consumers (prices and range of imports); farm groups are concerned about competition.
批准法通过后，协定全面生效仍取决于所有成员国和欧盟程序。: Even after approval, full entry into force depends on all member states and EU procedures.
监护法中的强制医疗：极少数情况下允许在医院以外进行: Coercive medical treatment under guardianship: allowed outside hospitals in narrow exceptions
联邦宪法法院2024年11月26日判决，强制医疗只能在医院进行的绝对规定在个别情: The Federal Constitutional Court ruled on 26 November 2024 that the absolute rule that coercive treatment may only take place in hospital can be a disproportionate interference in individual cases, and required new rules by the end of 2026. The government bill would allow it outside hospitals in narrowly defined exceptions while strengthening the last-resort principle and self-determination.
监护人只能同意在住院期间实施的强制医疗。: A guardian may consent to coercive treatment only during a hospital stay.
严格例外下允许在其他场所（如护理机构）实施。: In strict exceptions it could be carried out elsewhere (e.g. care homes).
影响受法定监护的人及其家属和照护机构。: Affects people under legal guardianship, their families and care facilities.
9月24日：一读；法院要求2026年底前完成修法。: 24 September: first reading; the court requires new rules by end-2026.

所有上网的人都相关。政府拟要求网络接入服务商把分配给客户的IP地址保存三个月，供: Relevant to everyone online. The government wants internet access providers to store the IP addresses assigned to customers for three months, so law enforcement and other authorised bodies can query them to trace online crime. Experts were sharply divided: the bar association fears disguised “data retention”, a federal prosecutor called it a milestone, and journalists’ unions worry about source protection.
现行法律没有普遍的IP地址保存义务。: Current law has no general obligation to retain IP addresses.
草案拟规定三个月保存义务和查询规则。: The bill would set a three-month retention duty and access rules.
若通过，你的上网IP地址分配记录将被保存三个月；内容和浏览记录不在此列（以最终文: If passed, records of which IP address you were assigned would be kept for three months; content and browsing history are not included (subject to the final text).
电网接入改革草案（“电网一揽子”）：新设备并网与电网建设同步，争议焦点“再调度保: Grid connection package: syncing new installations with grid expansion; “redispatch reservation” is the main dispute
政府拟让可再生能源设备和储能的新增与实际电网建设更好协调，并改进并网程序。核心是: The government wants better coordination between new renewable installations and storage and actual grid expansion, and to improve connection procedures. 被电网要求减少发电的设备通常获得补偿。: Installations told to curtail output usually receive compensation.
草案拟在拥堵地区限制新设备的补偿。: The bill would limit compensation for new installations in congested areas.
计划在拥堵地区安装大型光伏或储能的人可能受影响；小型屋顶设备的适用范围以最终文本: People planning large solar or storage in congested areas may be affected; whether small rooftop systems are covered depends on the final text.

草案生效后，主管机关须按新结论审查并更新许可。: Once in force, authorities must review and update permits under the new conclusions.

这是内阁草案；具体过渡期和限值以公布文本为准。: This is a cabinet draft; transition periods and limits follow the published text.

影响相关工业设施；对居民没有直接义务。: Affects the plants concerned; no direct obligations for residents.

政府拟落实欧盟新规定并全面重写国际刑事司法协助法，结构更清晰，并新设针对引渡或移: The government wants to implement new EU rules and fully rewrite the law on international mutual legal assistance in criminal matters, with clearer structure and a new remedy against the admissibility of extradition or surrender. 现行法律对引渡可采性的救济有限。: Current law offers limited remedies on the admissibility of extradition.
草案拟新设救济途径。: The bill would create a new remedy.
主要影响被请求引渡的人和司法机关。: Mainly affects people facing extradition and the judiciary.
社团法修订草案：完善“外国人社团登记册”，数据可转交安全机关: Associations act amendment: fuller register of foreigners’ associations, data shared with security agencies
参加外国人社团（成员主要为外国人的社团）或外国社团在德分支的人需要关注。政府拟提: People involved in foreigners’ associations (mainly foreign members) or German branches of foreign associations should take note. 相关社团可能面临更多申报义务；具体义务以最终法律为准。: The associations concerned may face more reporting duties; details follow the final law.

Experts at the hearing unanimously supported a minimum of five years’ imprisonment in such cases. A similar Bundesrat bill is considered alongside.
现行法律中“迷药”是否属于加重情节有争议。: Whether knockout drops count as an aggravating “weapon or dangerous tool” is disputed under current law.
草案拟明确并提高最低刑罚。: The bill would clarify this and raise the minimum sentence.
加重对此类犯罪的惩处；对一般居民没有新义务。: Tougher punishment for such crimes; no new obligations for the public.
反歧视法改革草案：主张权利的期限从2个月延至4个月，设调解机构: Anti-discrimination act reform: deadline to claim rights extended from 2 to 4 months, mediation body created
在求职、工作或租房等方面遭受歧视的人需要关注。政府拟修改《一般平等待遇法》：主张: People facing discrimination in job seeking, work or renting should take note. The government wants to amend the General Equal Treatment Act: the deadline to assert claims such as compensation would be extended from two to four months; a mediation body would be set up at the Federal Anti-Discrimination Agency, which could also take a greater part in court cases. Disability groups say the reform is too weak; employers say it goes too far.
现行：须在两个月内书面主张权利。: Currently: claims must be asserted in writing within two months.
草案拟延长到四个月，并设调解。: The bill would extend this to four months and add mediation.
例：若草案生效，被拒租的房客有四个月时间书面主张权利（现在只有两个月）。: Example: if passed, a rejected tenant would have four months to assert rights in writing (two months now).
能效法改革草案：落实欧盟能效指令，并把德国超出欧盟的要求降回欧盟水平: Energy efficiency bill: implementing the EU directive and cutting German rules back to the EU minimum
政府拟落实2023年修订的欧盟能效指令（2023/1791），同时把德国《能效法: The government wants to implement the revised EU Energy Efficiency Directive (2023/1791) and at the same time roll back most German Energy Efficiency Act rules that go beyond EU requirements (“gold-plating”) to relieve business, for example rules on data centres and corporate energy management. 德国《能效法》部分要求高于欧盟。: Parts of the German Energy Efficiency Act exceed EU requirements.
草案拟降至欧盟水平并落实指令。: The bill would align with the EU minimum and implement the directive.
主要影响企业和数据中心；对家庭没有直接义务。: Mainly affects companies and data centres; no direct obligations for households.
网络安全强化法草案：国家获得主动发现和抵御网络攻击的新权力: Cybersecurity bill: new state powers to detect and repel cyberattacks
政府拟赋予联邦机关新的网络防御权力，及早识别并抵御网络攻击，包括在一定条件下介入: The government wants to give federal authorities new cyber-defence powers to detect and repel attacks early, including, under conditions, intervening in IT systems used by attack victims. Experts accepted the need but called for safeguards such as judicial approval for covert or intrusive measures. The bill has not been passed.
现行法律对主动网络防御的授权有限。: Current law gives limited authority for active cyber defence.
草案拟设新权力。: The bill would create new powers.
若通过，国家机关在应对网络攻击时可能接触到被攻击的私人或企业系统；保障措施以最终: If passed, authorities responding to attacks might access affected private or company systems; safeguards follow the final law.

拟扩至约138公顷，新增区域有农业限制。: It would reach about 138 hectares, with farming limits in the new area.

欧盟航空乘客权利改革已公布：2027年10月23日起适用，延误3小时仍可获赔: EU air passenger rights reform published: applies from 23 October 2027, compensation still from a 3-hour delay
坐飞机的人需要关注。欧盟修订航空乘客权利条例，2027年10月23日起适用。到达: People who fly should take note. The EU amended its air passenger rights regulation, applying from 23 October 2027. Arriving more than 3 hours late still entitles you to EUR 250, 400 or 600; airlines must tell you electronically within 96 hours of the journey whether you can claim and how; after a 5-hour departure delay they must offer reimbursement; if they do not offer rerouting within 3 hours you may reroute yourself; after 2 hours on the tarmac passengers must be allowed to disembark; name spelling errors must be corrected free at least once if requested 48 hours before departure; and fares including hand baggage must be shown by default when booking.
现行第261/2004号条例：到达延误3小时以上可获250/400/600欧元；: Current Regulation 261/2004: arrival delays of over 3 hours give EUR 250/400/600; airlines have no duty to inform you of your claim within a set time; self-rerouting, tarmac delays and name corrections are not clearly regulated.
2027年10月23日起：补偿金额仍为250/400/600欧元，触发门槛仍是到: From 23 October 2027: compensation stays EUR 250/400/600 with the trigger still an arrival delay of over 3 hours; the third band (long-haul) may be halved where the arrival delay is at most 4 hours and conditions are met; new 96-hour information duty, reimbursement at 5 hours, self-rerouting if none offered within 3 hours, 2-hour tarmac limit, free name correction, default display of fares with hand baggage, and full compensation for mobility equipment of passengers with disabilities.
假设示例：2027年11月从法兰克福飞马德里（约1,450公里），到达晚了3.5: Hypothetical example: in November 2027 you fly Frankfurt–Madrid (about 1,450 km) and arrive 3.5 hours late without extraordinary circumstances: you can get EUR 250, and the airline must tell you electronically within 96 hours how to claim. On Frankfurt–New York (long-haul), a 3.5-hour late arrival may give only half of EUR 600, i.e. EUR 300, where the halving conditions are met.
在2027年10月23日之前，所有航班仍按现行规则。特殊情况（如恶劣天气）免除补: Until 23 October 2027 all flights follow the current rules. Exemptions for extraordinary circumstances (such as bad weather) still apply; see the full text, as this explanation lists only the main changes.

不少照护者同时工作或上学；政府认为现有支持不足以避免过度负担。: Many carers also work or study; the government considers support insufficient to prevent overload.
市镇从2027年起每年获得额外2,500万欧元，用于组织照护者支持；政府与市镇协: Municipalities are to receive an additional EUR 25 million each year from 2027 to organise support, assisted by a joint government and municipal-association team.
照护者及其家庭、雇主、学校和提供支持的市镇。2,500万欧元是全国市镇服务经费，: Carers and their families, employers, schools and municipalities providing support. EUR 25 million is nationwide municipal-service funding, not an amount an individual carer can claim.
公告没有创设已经可申请的新照护假，也没有给出个人服务资格、地方名额或补贴标准。配: The announcement creates no new leave entitlement already available to claim and gives no individual service eligibility, local capacity or payment rate. Separate rules for carer and family housing still need to be checked.
国家文化补助由主管部及六个国家文化基金分配；公告指出流程复杂、职责存在重叠。: National cultural subsidies are distributed by the ministry and six national cultural funds; the announcement identifies complex procedures and overlapping responsibilities.
拟修改法律延长最长补助期限，并让基金承担更大职责，同时保留较短期资助。: A legal amendment would extend the maximum grant period and give funds greater responsibilities, while retaining shorter grants.
领取或申请国家文化补助的机构、创作者和文化基金。: Institutions and creators receiving or applying for national cultural grants, and the funds administering them.
内阁批准的是改革计划，不是已经发放八年资助；具体资格、金额和基金安排尚待确定。: The cabinet approved a reform plan, not eight-year grant awards. Eligibility, amounts and the final structure of the funds remain to be decided.
官方仍将2027年启动称为目标，不能把拟议掺混义务当作当前已执行的要求。: The official announcement still treats a 2027 start as a target; the proposed blending obligation must not be treated as an operating requirement.
按供应商在ETS2覆盖行业供气中的市场份额分配义务：2027年相当于减排63万吨: The obligation would be allocated by suppliers’ market share in gas supplied to ETS2 sectors: equivalent to 0.63 million tonnes of CO₂ savings in 2027 and 2.85 million tonnes annually from 2031.
能源供应商承担义务，家庭燃气账单可能受到成本转嫁影响。政府估计首年额外成本最多每: Suppliers bear the obligation; households may face passed-through costs. The government estimates additional first-year costs of at most 1.5 euro cents per cubic metre.
例如，假设全年用气1,000立方米且按1.5欧分全额转嫁，增加15欧元，不含增值: For example, assuming 1,000 cubic metres of annual use and full pass-through at 1.5 cents, the increase would be EUR 15 excluding VAT. This is not a fixed charge or price guarantee. The 2031 figure of 9 cents per cubic metre is likewise an estimated ceiling. Final rules, the Senate outcome and commencement text still require verification.
这是对Wtta许可制度的配套调整，不能把本次征求意见当作Wtta本身或同等待遇主: This is an implementing change to the Wtta licensing system; the consultation is not passage of Wtta itself or of the underlying equal-treatment legislation.
检查范围包括工资和休假；发现不符先允许整改，未改正可暂停或撤回许可，并增加用于证: Checks would cover pay and leave. Non-compliance would first allow remediation, followed by possible licence suspension or withdrawal. The proposal also adds ways to evidence turnover for licensing fees.
派遣企业、借用劳动力的企业及被派遣员工，尤其涉及许可合规和劳动待遇。: Labour suppliers, user companies and supplied workers, particularly their licensing compliance and employment conditions.
主管部公告称Wtta于2027年1月1日启动、拟使用过渡安排的企业须此前登记、2: The ministry states that Wtta starts on 1 January 2027, registration for transitional arrangements is required before then, and enforcement starts in 2028. This review verifies that announcement; the primary and commencement texts still require separate confirmation. July 2027 for the added check is a planned date.
公告称目前只有特定情况下可处罚妨碍遣返，例如涉及入境禁令或不受欢迎人员决定。: The announcement says punishment is currently possible only in specific circumstances, for example involving an entry ban or an undesirability declaration.
草案拟扩大刑事处置范围，例子包括拒绝提供身份资料、提供错误资料或拒绝为遣返办理必: The draft would widen the criminal response, with examples including withholding or falsifying identity information and refusing to obtain necessary travel documents.
涉及无合法居留且主动阻挠遣返的特定人群；不能据此说所有移民、庇护申请人或无证居留: Affects the specified group lacking lawful residence and actively frustrating return; it does not mean all migrants, asylum applicants or people without status automatically commit a new offence.
这是咨询草案，尚未通过。公告没有列明最高刑期、完整犯罪构成或生效日期，本站不补填: This is a consultation draft, not enacted law. The announcement gives no maximum sentence, complete offence definition or commencement date, and none is inferred here. Inability to leave for reasons outside a person’s control must not be conflated with active obstruction.
此前的500项规则计划只面向企业。: The earlier 500-rule programme covered businesses only.
拟通过取消或简化规则、减少报告、改善数据交换及表格等方式减轻负担；2027年下半: The programme would reduce burdens through repeals, simplification, less reporting, better data exchange and simpler forms. Another 250 rules are targeted in the second half of 2027, then 500 each year from 2028.
企业、居民和专业服务人员；实际权利义务变化取决于每项具体修法或行政调整。: Businesses, residents and professionals; actual changes to rights and duties depend on each specific legal or administrative amendment.
公告另提及简化法作为可能的立法工具，但不提供每项规则的最终文本或生效日期。不能据: The announcement also refers to a simplification bill as a possible legislative vehicle but provides no final text or commencement date for each rule. Existing requirements cannot be disregarded on this basis.
产生氮沉降的新项目及现有设施改造，目前很难取得所需自然保护许可。: New projects and changes to existing facilities that cause nitrogen deposition currently struggle to obtain the required nature permits.
先补强自然区管理计划、治理外来物种及改善水文和生物多样性，再据自然目标评估项目许: Management plans would first be strengthened, with invasive-species control and improvements to hydrology and biodiversity, then permits assessed against nature objectives. A separate port-equipment electrification grant is planned to open in early 2027.
鹿特丹港相关企业、设施改造及周边建设项目。5,000万欧元用于自然措施，不是向每: Relevant port businesses, installation upgrades and nearby construction projects. EUR 50 million funds nature measures; it is not a grant amount available to each business.
开始受理或发放许可仍取决于管理计划、生态条件及逐案审查；公告未给出补助申请规则和: Permitting still depends on management plans, ecological conditions and individual assessment. The announcement gives no grant application rules or exact opening date.
部分地区线路减少、学校和医院更难到达，同时高峰拥挤和非高峰空驶并存。: Some regions face reduced services and poorer access to schools and hospitals, alongside peak crowding and off-peak empty vehicles.
公布持续投入3亿欧元支持区域通达性和基础设施连接，具体分配另行说明；同时推进错峰: A recurring EUR 300 million investment is announced for regional accessibility and infrastructure connections, with allocations to follow. The plan also promotes off-peak travel and autonomous-vehicle and rapid-bus pilots.
区域居民、通勤者、学生、需要照护的人及运输经营者；不是每位乘客领取3亿欧元的一部: Regional residents, commuters, students, people needing care and transport operators; the funding is not an individual passenger entitlement.
资金用途、票价产品、各地服务和时间表尚待细化；现有泽兰预约交通例子不等于全国已经: Funding allocation, any fare product, regional services and timetables remain to be developed. The existing Zeeland bookable-transport example does not mean identical service already exists nationwide.
Quantum Delta NL此前已获拨6.149亿欧元；这是既有投入，不是本: EUR 614.9 million had already been allocated to Quantum Delta NL; this is existing funding, not an equal new allocation in this announcement.
拟探索进一步公共及私人融资，以研究、政府采购和新设颠覆性创新机构推动应用，并安排: The strategy explores further public and private financing, research, government procurement and a new disruptive-innovation agency, alongside government risk management and international cooperation.
量子企业、科研机构、政府信息系统及可能采用量子技术的行业。: Quantum businesses, research institutions, government information systems and sectors that may adopt quantum technology.
战略本身没有公布针对普通居民的新义务、企业统一迁移截止日或量子计算机已经能破解现: The strategy announces no new duty for ordinary residents, uniform business migration deadline or finding that quantum computers can already break current encryption. Specific budgets and measures require separate verification.
这是更广泛的网络歧视应对计划中的公众参与环节。: This is the public-participation element of a wider plan to address online discrimination.
线上可回应议题或提出新议题；线下报名超过名额时抽签。: Participants can respond to or propose topics online; oversubscribed in-person sessions use a lottery.
希望表达经历和意见的居民；参与不等于提交司法投诉。: Residents wishing to share experiences and opinions; participation is not a judicial complaint.
本次公告没有设立新的违法行为或处罚标准，也不表示讨论意见已经成为法律。: The announcement creates no new offence or penalty and does not turn participants’ views into law.
公告指出老龄化及劳动者技能与岗位需求不匹配。: The announcement identifies population ageing and mismatches between workers’ skills and job demand.
建议包括培养和吸引重点行业学生、加强继续教育、调整课程并减少妨碍地区合作的规则；: Proposals include training and attracting students in priority sectors, continuing education, adaptable courses and removing barriers to regional cooperation. Parliament is to be informed of next steps around year-end.
学生、转岗及在职学习人员、教育机构和雇主。: Students, workers retraining or studying, education providers and employers.
这是协商和实施方案制定阶段，没有公布可申请的新个人补助、入学资格或强制课程。: This is a consultation and programme-development stage; no new individual grant, admission entitlement or mandatory course is announced.
政府认为现有《外国船舶法》的相关执法权限不足，需修法扩展；现有法律并未因提交而改: The government considers relevant powers under the Foreign Ships Act insufficient and seeks an amendment. Submission has not changed existing law.
拟提高冒用荷兰王国旗帜航行的最高刑期至四年；实际适用须依最终条文及国际海洋法条件: The maximum prison term for sailing under a false Kingdom flag would rise to four years, subject to the final statutory provisions and international law of the sea.
相关船舶运营者、船长及海上执法机构；不等于授权不受限制地拦截所有外国船舶。: Relevant vessel operators, masters and maritime enforcement authorities; it is not an unrestricted power to intercept all foreign ships.

需要生活、学习等综合帮助的受影响家庭。两年不是所有服务必须停止的日期；已安排的多: Affected families needing broader help with living, education and other needs. Two years is not a universal service end date: an agreed multi-year course or other support can continue longer.

此处解读官方发布说明；计划及附件的项目细则尚未逐项核对。公告没有设立居民强制用电: This explanation covers the official announcement; individual project rules in the plan and annex have not all been checked. 本轮小型社会倡议补助1000—3500欧元，总预算45万欧元已于10月5日达到。: This small community-initiative round offers EUR 1,000–3,500. Its EUR 450,000 budget was reached on 5 October. Only applications received that day enter a notarial lottery determining assessment order, without guaranteeing approval.
上艾瑟尔小型社会倡议补助本轮进入抽签: Overijssel small community grants move to a lottery
9月7日公告安排10月5日09:00开放；名义窗口为10月5日至11月13日，但: The 7 September announcement scheduled opening at 09:00 on 5 October. The nominal window ran to 13 November, with lottery ordering if opening-day requests reached the budget.
当前门户确认首日预算已满，只把10月5日收到的申请纳入抽签。补助最高覆盖合资格费: The current portal confirms the opening-day budget threshold was reached and limits the lottery to applications received on 5 October. Grants cover up to 100% of eligible costs; only each applicant’s first received application is assessed.
在上艾瑟尔共同筹办免费开放、非营利社区活动的居民、协会及其他符合条件的组织。: Residents, associations and other eligible organisations jointly developing freely accessible, non-profit community activities in Overijssel.
抽签后仍须满足资格条件。活动须尚未开始、得到居民支持；仅第三方费用合资格，第三方: Eligibility is assessed after the lottery. Activities must not have started and need resident support. Only third-party costs qualify, with third-party labour capped at EUR 130 per hour excluding VAT; applicants’ own and volunteer hours do not qualify. The same activity cannot duplicate a provincial subsidy; the canal scheme is separate. 13 November is not a remaining deadline for joining this round’s lottery.
首日申请达到预算，转入抽签: Opening-day requests reach the budget; lottery follows
现行文化专项政策法把补助期限定为最长4年。7月10日提交的36993号法案拟把上: The current Specific Cultural Policy Act limits grants to four years. Bill 36993, submitted on 10 July, proposes an eight-year maximum; the reviewed dossier shows written preparation but no vote.
提交最长8年文化补助期法案: Bill submitted for an eight-year maximum cultural grant period

参议院档案确认10月6日众议院通过，10月13日委员会讨论程序；未记录参议院通过: The Senate dossier confirms lower-house passage on 6 October and a committee procedure discussion on 13 October; it records no Senate passage or promulgation.
经济事务／气候与绿色增长委员会安排讨论程序，不是已确定的最终表决。: The Economic Affairs / Climate and Green Growth committee is scheduled to discuss procedure, not hold a confirmed final vote.
众议院已通过，但参议院尚未完成审议；法定生效日须另由王室法令指定。2027年为政: The lower house has passed the bill, but Senate scrutiny remains unfinished; commencement requires a separate royal decree. 2027 is the government’s implementation target, and costs are estimates rather than fixed tax rates or current charges.
