新喀里多尼亚本地出生且在一般选民名册上的人纳入省级特别选民团: New Caledonia adds locally born general-roll voters to the provincial special electorate
组织法把在新喀里多尼亚出生、选举日列于一般选民名册的人，加入国会及省议会选举的特: The organic law adds people born in New Caledonia and registered on the general electoral roll on election day to the special electorate for Congress and provincial assemblies, with automatic special-roll registration. It does not remove all restrictions on that electorate.
原特别选民团按努美阿协定及1999年组织法设置资格，包含历史投票资格、居住和父母: The special electorate followed the Nouméa Accord and 1999 organic law, including historical voting, residence and parental-eligibility routes. Local birth alone did not previously automatically confer this special electoral status.
新法增加第188条第一款d项出生地加一般名册资格，并修改第189条依职权登记规则: The law adds article 188(I)(d), combining local birth with general-roll registration, and amends article 189 for automatic registration. The Constitutional Council upheld it on 28 May. Article 2 starts it the day after gazette publication: 30 May following publication on 29 May.
符合条件的选民应核对一般名册及特别名册实际登记；只在当地居住但非当地出生者不能仅: Eligible voters should check actual general and special-roll entries. Residence without local birth does not satisfy this new route. The law does not directly alter the electorate for French national elections or self-determination referendums.
合宪决定明确保留特别选民团受限性质。本次核实资格修法与生效日，未核实个人登记结果: The constitutional ruling expressly retains the restricted nature of the electorate. This review verifies the eligibility amendment and commencement, not individual registration or the next election timetable, and does not treat it as completion of all constitutional reform.
法国承认十氯酮污染责任并设修复目标，未自动开放全民赔偿: France recognises responsibility for chlordecone pollution without automatically opening universal compensation
法律承认国家对瓜德罗普和马提尼克十氯酮污染所致健康、精神、生态及经济损害承担部分: The law recognises the state’s share of responsibility for health, moral, ecological and economic damage from chlordecone pollution in Guadeloupe and Martinique, setting remediation, research and compensation objectives. Its reference to compensation does not create an immediate fixed payment for every resident.
已有农药受害者赔偿基金及污染治理工作。本法在此基础上承认国家责任，并要求评估将现: A pesticide-victim compensation fund and pollution-control work already exist. The law recognises state responsibility and requires assessment of extending the fund to occupational and non-occupational exposure victims; examining expansion is not the same as implementing it.
国家须推进土地及水体去污、减少食品暴露、支持农业渔业和女性相关疾病研究，并制定多: The state must pursue soil/water remediation, reduced food exposure, agricultural/fishing support and research on effects in women, with a multi-year strategy. Parliamentary scientific evaluation is due within one year of promulgation and every three years thereafter; the government must also assess fund expansion within one year.
受影响居民应区分现有基金资格与本法提出的更广赔偿目标；法律未写出普遍赔偿额或自动: Residents should distinguish existing fund eligibility from the wider compensation objective. No universal amount or automatic claim route is specified. Support and decontamination objectives likewise do not establish that particular land is clean or a product certified safe.
最终通过文本第3条仍写2026年1月1日报告截止日，早于6月公布；保留这一原文日: Final article 3 retains a report deadline of 1 January 2026, preceding June enactment; this textual inconsistency is retained rather than converted into a future promise. The Senate tracker of 9 July listed reports as pending and does not settle October status. The strategy, disease list and fund-expansion implementation remain unverified here.
法国9月起缩短个人协商解约后的失业金最长期限: France shortens maximum unemployment benefit after individual mutual termination from September
6月法律为按个人协商解约类别调整失业金期限提供依据，随后批准的协议从9月1日起适: The June law enables duration rules specific to individual mutual termination, with the approved agreement applying from 1 September. The dividing date is actual contract termination, not signature or unemployment registration.
此前法国本土最长期限按年龄通常为不足55岁18个月、55—56岁22.5个月、5: Previous mainland maxima were generally 18 months below age 55, 22.5 months at 55–56 and 27 months from 57; overseas maxima excluding Mayotte were 24, 30 and 36 months. The duration ceiling is distinct from the daily amount.
9月1日起实际终止的个人协商解约，本土不足55岁上限15个月、55岁起20.5个: For individual mutual terminations effective from 1 September, mainland ceilings become 15 months below 55 and 20.5 months from 55; overseas excluding Mayotte they are 20 and 30 months. Earlier terminations retain old limits. Collective mutual terminations are excluded, and ARE amounts still follow ordinary calculation rules.
55岁起可申请按求职或职业项目情况延长，须经France Travail审查，并: From age 55, an extension may be requested subject to France Travail assessment of job-search or professional-project efforts, rather than automatic restoration. Applications generally remain possible for 30 days after the cap, but must precede exhaustion where rights can reload. Refusal can be referred to the regional/territorial joint body within 30 days of notification.
这里列的是最大期限，不是每人保证领取时长；仍需满足保险记录、登记及求职等一般条件: These are maxima, not guaranteed individual entitlements; insurance, registration and job-search conditions still apply. Implementation is checked against the labour ministry’s 10 July guidance and Unédic’s 7 October update. Earlier parliamentary rejection or draft terms do not determine current law, and Mayotte is not placed in the same table.

法国明确消防医疗与心理专业职责，任务委托仍受细则约束: France defines fire-service health and psychological roles, with delegation subject to regulations
法律为消防救援部门的医生、药剂师、护士、心理专业人员及兽医建立明确职责，并规定多: The law defines roles for doctors, pharmacists, nurses, psychological professionals and veterinarians in fire/rescue services and provides for a multidisciplinary health unit. It does not authorise every rescue worker to perform medical acts regardless of qualification.
消防救援与急救职责已存在，但各医疗专业的任务需要更完整的法定定位。改革把急救、人: Fire/rescue and urgent-care duties already existed, while professional roles needed a fuller statutory framework. The reform distinguishes emergency care, personnel treatment, fitness/prevention medicine, training/research and professional management.
医生可承担救援急救、消防人员及预备役和职员诊疗、适岗预防及研究管理等任务；对护士: Doctors cover emergency care, treatment of firefighters/reservists/staff, fitness/prevention and research/management. Delegation to nurses requires regulatory conditions. Pharmacists cover pharmacies and relevant risks; nursing staff provide care/coordination; psychological professionals provide care, prevention and support; veterinary roles include animal-health risks and canine teams.
消防部门可据此组织多专业团队，巴黎消防旅和马赛海军消防营的文职卫生人员也在适用范: Services can organise multidisciplinary teams, including the civilian health personnel of the Paris fire brigade and Marseille naval fire battalion. Professional ethics and scopes remain binding; other health experts participate only within their own professional limits.
参议院10月7日跟踪页仍列医生任务、委托、培训及其他专业职责细则待公布；之后状态: The Senate tracker of 7 October still listed rules on doctors’ duties, delegation, training and other professions as pending; later publication is unverified. Enactment does not establish operational authority for every delegation or a new pay scale or public clinic route.
法国简化共有财产分割与无人承受遗产管理，未普遍降为简单多数出售: France simplifies co-ownership and vacant estates without a general simple-majority sale rule
法律改善无主财产信息、无人承受遗产管理及司法分割程序。原草案的普遍降低出售多数门: The law improves ownerless-property information, vacant-estate administration and judicial partition. The proposal for a general lower sale majority was not retained; notification, objection and judicial safeguards remain central.
共有物处分通常受较严格同意规则约束；保全、日常管理与出售的规则本就不同。继承人失: Different rules already governed preservation, ordinary management and disposal of shared assets. Missing heirs, disagreement and estate-administration procedures can cause deadlock; the law makes targeted procedural changes without abolishing property protection.
税务机关可依条件向市镇提供必要产权信息；遗产公告可在保留原法定刊载的同时增加政府: Tax authorities may provide necessary property information to municipalities under conditions. Digital estate notices supplement existing publication, administrators may mandate signature and handle movable/immovable sales more flexibly. Courts may authorise one co-owner to sell under urgency/common-interest conditions. The specific Corsican route retains a two-thirds threshold, notarial notification and three-month objection period, with judicial review if opposed.
第7条扩展司法清算分割规则至夫妻、PACS伴侣及同居者复杂财产结算，并调整分割法: Article 7 extends judicial liquidation/partition procedures to complex property settlements involving spouses, PACS partners and cohabitants and adjusts the supervising judge’s role. Parties must identify the ordinary, specific Corsican or urgent judicial route rather than selling any French co-owned home by a bare majority.
参议院10月7日仍列第7条有关分割法官争议及拍卖权限的配套命令待公布；旧案具体过: The Senate tracker of 7 October still lists implementing rules for article 7 on disputes and judicial sales as pending; transition for older cases is unverified. The law does not change inheritance-tax rates and does not enact the separate October inheritance/gift-tax proposal.

法国未成年人数字保护法保留校园手机规则，15岁以下全面禁网条款被剔除: France retains school-phone rules after the blanket under-15 social-network ban is struck down
宪法委员会8月14日剔除第1条广泛禁止15岁以下使用社交网络的规定；其余条款仍随: The Constitutional Council struck down article 1’s broad under-15 social-network ban on 14 August; the remaining provisions were promulgated on 24 August. School-phone rules extend to lycées from the 2026 school year, so partial invalidation does not mean the whole law failed.
幼儿园、小学及初中已有手机使用限制；高中此前并非统一适用同一法定禁用范围。线上未: Phone-use restrictions already applied in nursery/primary schools and collèges; lycées were not universally covered by the same statutory restriction. Existing EU DSA duties independently protect minors online and are not removed by this ruling.
保留条款要求学校项目包括理性数字使用和屏幕、成瘾风险教育，把手机及联网设备禁用范: Surviving provisions require school planning on reasonable digital use and screen/addiction risks, extend phone/connected-device restrictions to lycées and leave implementation/exceptions to school rules. Medical needs and higher-education students hosted in lycées require specific treatment. Another provision includes Penal Code 223-14 suicide-promotion content in the relevant platform/account-restriction mechanisms.
家长和学生应查校规规定的保管方式、医疗例外与分级处理，不能推定全国都必须用同一种: Families should check school storage arrangements, medical exceptions and proportionate responses rather than assume a single national pouch or sanction. The rejected article’s September ban for new accounts and four-month transition for existing accounts cannot be enforced on that basis.
裁决理由包括过宽限制表达通信自由和年龄核验隐私保障不足，不是否认所有儿童保护。1: The ruling concerns disproportionate restrictions on expression/communication and inadequate age-check privacy safeguards, not a rejection of all child protection. France’s October European resolution 3281 and the EU KIDS initiative are separate proposals rather than a replacement blanket ban already in force. School-use restrictions are not a ban on owning a phone outside school.

法国为合资格企业内部法律意见设保密保护，刑事与税务程序除外: France protects qualifying in-house legal advice, excluding criminal and tax proceedings
法律建立有条件的内部法律咨询保密制度，须满足学历、伦理培训、收件对象、内容和标识: The law creates conditional confidentiality for in-house legal advice, with qualification, ethics-training, recipient, content and labelling/filing requirements. It is not secrecy for every company document and cannot defeat criminal, tax or reserved EU investigative powers.
企业内部法律意见需要与外聘律师职业保密、普通商业文件区分。本法新增1971年法律: In-house advice must be distinguished from external lawyers’ professional secrecy and ordinary business records. New article 58-1 of the 1971 law creates a dedicated protection while retaining regulatory and judicial checks.
作者须具法学硕士或等值资格，企业法务须完成雇主付费伦理培训；意见限指定公司或集团: The author needs a law master’s or equivalent, and the in-house lawyer must complete employer-funded ethics training. Advice must be personalised legal analysis for designated company/group governance recipients, specially labelled, attributed and filed. Article 2 provides transitional recognition for specified earlier qualifications or first-year master’s equivalents plus eight years’ relevant practice at commencement.
民商事及行政程序中的保密争议采用封存和法官审查，企业可放弃保护，相关司法程序须律: Civil, commercial and administrative disputes use sealing and judicial review; the company may waive protection and counsel is required in the relevant court process. Constitutional reservations also permit challenges during statutory information requests, preserve organic-law powers and allow lifting confidentiality for advice facilitating fraud against law or third-party rights.
法律由命令确定启动日，最迟为公布签署后第十二个月首日，即按2月23日推算2027: Commencement is set by decree, no later than the first day of the twelfth month following promulgation: 1 February 2027 calculated from 23 February. No earlier commencement decree or ethics-training rules were verified in this official-source search, so full operation from February publication is not claimed. Criminal/tax exceptions, direct or delegated EU investigations and ordinary contracts/decisions are not defeated by a confidentiality stamp.
法国设非法取得文化财产返还框架，须经来源审查及国家间申请: France creates an illicit cultural-property restitution framework requiring provenance review and a state request
法律为法国公共财产中的合资格文化物品设退出公共领域、返还请求国的程序，适用于18: The law provides a route to remove qualifying cultural objects from French public ownership and return them to a requesting state, covering specified illicit acquisitions between 20 November 1815 and 23 April 1972. It is neither automatic restitution of all foreign-origin objects nor direct collection by private claimants.
公共领域不可转让原则一直限制馆藏处分，特定对象此前往往需专门立法。新框架以来源、: Inalienability has constrained disposal of public collections, with specific objects often requiring individual legislation. The new framework depends on provenance, acquisition circumstances and scientific scrutiny and connects with the existing route for later illicit exports.
请求须由物品现今来源国提出，可代表仍在其领土的群体；需证实或以严肃、明确且一致线: The present-day state of origin must request return, potentially for a group still on its territory. Theft, pillage, coercion/violence or transfer without authority must be established or supported by serious, precise and concordant evidence. Exclusions for prior international agreements, specified archaeological sharing/exchange and militarily used captures require review. A bilateral scientific report and reasoned national-commission opinion precede removal by Conseil d’État decree.
非国家公共主体拥有的物品还需该主体同意；捐赠遗赠适用但相反条款触发捐赠人或继承人: Objects owned by another public body require its approval. Gifts and legacies are covered, but contrary donor terms trigger notification/consent arrangements; six months’ silence after the last notice/publicity permits the statutory route to continue. Competing state claims require diplomatic resolution, and title transfers to the requesting state.
第3条明确覆盖公布时仍在审查的请求，不必把旧申请一概重启；执行细则、个别退出命令: Article 3 expressly includes requests under examination at publication rather than requiring every earlier claim to restart. Implementing rules, individual removal decrees and actual handovers are unverified here. This framework is distinct from the specific Guyana human-remains burial law and does not establish that the same objects have already been returned.
法国简化地方防洪工程程序，私人土地和环境审查仍有条件: France streamlines local flood-prevention works with land and environmental safeguards
法律调整河道维护、防洪行动计划（PAPI）、地役权和紧急征收程序，服务于地方政府: The law changes river maintenance, flood-prevention action programmes (PAPI), easements and urgent possession procedures for local authorities and GEMAPI bodies. It does not let residents dredge freely or authorities take land unconditionally.
地方防洪此前适用分散的水环境、公共调查与土地取得程序；修法把部分程序衔接，并扩大: Local flood works have followed separate water, public-inquiry and land-acquisition procedures; the amendments connect them and widen specific simplified routes.
第2条把特定环境许可公众咨询期定为45天；第3条对自然水环境恢复工程的免公共调查: Article 2 sets a 45-day public-consultation period for the specified environmental-permit procedure. Article 3 exempts natural aquatic restoration works from public inquiry only without expropriation, charges to interested people or a required environmental assessment; explicit owner consent is also needed outside the six-metre easement strip. PAPI gains a statutory framework and review-time rules, with reuse of assessed project material.
对已认定公共利益的PAPI工程，只有严重人身安全风险、取得土地受阻等条件满足时，: Exceptional early possession for public-interest PAPI works requires serious safety risks and acquisition obstacles, with a decree approved by the Conseil d’État. Local bodies may create technical-staff support reserves; limited plan amendments and material-error corrections follow different procedures.
实施跟踪最后更新于7月20日，仍列审查时限、技术储备等细则待公布，不能据此断言1: The tracker last updated on 20 July still lists rules on review deadlines and technical reserves as pending; that does not establish their absence in October. Individual permits, grants, possession decisions and pending-application transitions are unverified. The law does not establish compensation for any specific flood loss.
法国快时尚法设生产者附加费框架，广告禁令定于2027年: France sets ultra-fast-fashion producer penalties and a 2027 advertising ban
法律针对大量新款与低维修激励相结合的“超快时尚”模式，涵盖生产者及特定线上平台。: The law targets ultra-fast-fashion practices combining many new references with weak repair incentives, covering producers and specified online platforms. Producer eco-contribution modulation provisions start on 1 September, with advertising and influencer-promotion bans on 1 January 2027. The penalty is not a uniform per-item consumer tax.
既有生产者延伸责任制度收取环保费用；新法加入产品系列规模、上新频率和维修激励的调: Existing extended producer responsibility already collects environmental contributions. The law adds range size, offer frequency and repair incentives as modulation factors, alongside origin display, platform messages and promotion restrictions.
最终文本第5条的每件罚性调节区间为2026年€0.25–12、2027年€0.5: Final article 5 sets per-item penalty ranges of €0.25–12 in 2026, €0.50–14 in 2027, €0.75–16 in 2028, €1–18 in 2029 and €2–20 from 2030, with category amounts specified separately. On a reasoned producer request, the eco-organisation must limit the amount to 50% of the pre-tax sale price. Penalised products cannot also receive the corresponding environmental bonuses.
广告禁令包括直接或间接推广及用“免费”作促销；网红违规行政罚款上限€100,00: The advertising rule covers direct/indirect promotion and “free” marketing; influencer breaches carry an administrative fine up to €100,000. Independent resale of unsold collections is excluded from the definition, and EU/EEA cross-border services have country-of-origin rules and special procedures. Cheap goods, second-hand clothes and foreign brands are not automatically all prohibited.
具体定义门槛、显示方式及广告细则尚须核实；7月20日实施跟踪不能证明10月状态。: Definition thresholds, display rules and advertising implementation still require verification; the 20 July tracker does not establish October status. Service Public says €2.20 for the 2030 floor and describes the 50% cap without its application condition; this account follows the final text’s €2 and reasoned-request requirement and records the discrepancy. Retrospective charges on old stock and brand classifications are unverified.

法国加强重病儿童家长休假与就业保护，部分试点年底才开始: France strengthens leave and job protection for parents of seriously ill children, with later pilots
法律改善重病、残障或严重意外儿童家长的就业、储蓄、住房及照护权利。就业保护等已经: The law improves employment, savings, housing and care rights for parents of children with serious illness, disability or severe accidents. Employment protections have changed, but ten-department pilots, shared-custody allowances and reimbursement requiring implementing rules are not all immediately nationwide.
照护假申请原需提前15天通知，确诊残障、癌症或规定慢性病的特殊假为5个工作日，A: Previously parental-presence leave required 15 days’ notice, the special leave following diagnosis of disability, cancer or specified chronic disease was five working days, and the maximum AJPP treatment-review interval was 12 months.
通知期缩至10天，确诊特殊假增至10个工作日；照护假结束后的10周也受解雇保护，: Notice falls to ten days and diagnosis-related leave rises to ten working days. Dismissal protection extends ten weeks beyond parental-presence leave, retaining exceptions for serious misconduct or inability to maintain the contract for reasons unrelated to the child’s health. The maximum AJPP review interval rises to 14 months, with wider access to adjusted hours, specified retirement-savings withdrawals and court-ordered credit-payment suspension.
规定长期病儿童在医疗方案内的Mon soutien psy不再受通常年度12次上: For qualifying children with long-term conditions, Mon soutien psy within a care protocol loses its usual annual 12-session cap. Other specialist care and neuropsychological assessments have prescription, contracting, approval and tariff conditions. A one-year, ten-department AEEH pilot provides a basic-amount advance after two months without a decision, for new applications from 12 December, six months after promulgation; participating departments require a specified list.
分居共同监护双方AJPP新路径在公布18个月后即2027年12月12日生效，仍有: The new AJPP route for both parents in effective shared custody starts 18 months after promulgation, on 12 December 2027, subject to conditions and rules; it does not permit double claims now. There are also parking-card pilots and hospital-parent accommodation measures. Pilot territories, specialist tariffs and retroactive treatment of old applications are unverified; future statutory dates are not presented as services already operating.

部分十省试点的法定起始日: Statutory start of specified ten-department pilots

法国把荣誉律师参与刑事法院的试点转为常设，并增设专项培训: France makes honorary-lawyer criminal-court appointments permanent and adds specialist training
组织法允许符合条件的荣誉律师担任省级刑事法院陪席法官，将原试点转为常设制度；任期: The organic law makes the former pilot for eligible honorary lawyers to sit as departmental criminal-court assessors permanent. Terms, geographical exclusions, training and a career-judge majority constrain it. It accompanies but is distinct from procedural reform under Law 2026-651.
此前荣誉律师参与采用2021年组织法的试验安排；现把任命及独立性规则纳入司法人员: Honorary-lawyer participation previously operated under the 2021 organic-law experiment; appointment and independence rules now become part of the judicial statute.
任期五年，可再任一次，75岁后不得留任；须至少三年未在拟任上诉法院辖区执业，并在: Appointments last five years, renewable once, with an age limit of 75. Appointees must not have practised as lawyers in the receiving appeal-court area for at least three years and must train and take an oath before serving. Professional connections require recusal; honorary lawyers together with temporary/honorary judges cannot form a majority.
经常处理家庭暴力的法官须在上任一年内专项培训，已在岗者过渡期限为2028年12月: Judges regularly handling domestic violence must receive specific training within a year of appointment; existing incumbents have until before 31 December 2028. Pre-service sexual and gender-based violence training for departmental criminal courts starts on 1 January 2027, the first day of the sixth month after promulgation. Those completing a first pilot term may take a second five-year term under the new conditions.
宪法委员会908 DC确认组织法合宪。10月2日实施页称无需规章，但最终文本41: Decision 908 DC upheld the organic law. The 2 October tracker says no regulations are required, while final articles 41-34 and 41-35 refer to rules on applications, training and compensation. That discrepancy is retained; complete operational rollout and a single procedural start date for all cases are not established.
刑事法院专项岗前培训起始日: Start of specific criminal-court pre-service training

法国设国有房地产公共机构转换框架，最迟2027年初完成: France sets a state-property public-body conversion framework due by early 2027
法律把国家房地产管理公司转为国家工商性公共机构，允许向其无偿移交国家房产并集中维: The law converts the state-property company into a national industrial and commercial public body, permitting free transfers of state assets for consolidated maintenance, renovation, leasing and disposal. A decree must set the conversion date and asset lists; publication does not mean every building has transferred.
原机构采用股份公司形式；新机制保留法人连续性，并以公共机构及其子公司管理国家不动: The existing agency is a company; the new mechanism preserves legal continuity while placing property management under a public body and its subsidiaries.
机构仍由国家控制，旗下受控公司集团私人资本合计不得超过合并资本30%。合资格公共: State control remains, with private holdings capped at 30% of consolidated capital across controlled companies. Decision 913 DC upheld qualifying public-service property-tax exemptions and specified transfer/conversion tax neutrality. The general conversion-related tax exemption excludes corporate income tax and does not create a private-buyer concession.
旧合同、权利、债务及授权不因法人形式转换失效；具体资产的管理责任自实际移交日承接: Existing contracts, rights, obligations and authorisations survive the change of form; management obligations follow each actual asset transfer. Relevant public staff are assigned for the transferred share of work for up to three years while retaining their existing status, with a later ordinance authorised within two years for the permanent regime. Intended disposals require notice to local authorities and the intermunicipal body.
转换最迟为2027年1月1日；9月14日实施跟踪仍列转换命令、筹备负责人及资产清: Conversion is due no later than 1 January 2027. The 14 September tracker still lists the conversion decree, preparatory appointment and asset list as pending, which does not establish October absence. Actual conversion, individual transfers and rents are unverified. The constitutional ruling examined specified tax clauses, not every operational decision.
法国山区法调整学校医疗服务和建设规则，湖岸与自然保护条件仍保留: France adjusts mountain services and building rules while retaining shore and landscape safeguards
法律涉及山区学校、医疗可达性、跨市治理、建设、牧业、非机动车户外活动及防洪。部分: The law covers mountain schools, access to care, intermunicipal governance, construction, pastoral activity, non-motorised recreation and flood protection. Some measures are planning duties or policy objectives, not proof of new schools, hospitals, reservoirs or building permissions in each village.
山区原有建设连续性及大湖周边海岸保护规则；新法细化连续性认定，并允许规划在有限地: Mountain areas already had development-continuity rules and coastal protection around large lakes. The law refines continuity and allows planning to coordinate the two regimes in limited sectors.
学校规划须提前提供三至五年人数变化预测并协商，山区条件影响开关班门槛。医疗规划须: School planning must provide three-to-five-year enrolment forecasts and consultation, with mountain conditions informing class-opening and closure thresholds. Health planning must consider reasonable travel times and emergency air transport in very isolated areas. Intermunicipal bodies combining mountain and other communes must establish a mountain committee.
建设可接续既有建筑群，但912 DC第19段解释只容许跨越较小物理间隔，山区景观: Construction may adjoin existing building groups, but paragraph 19 of 912 DC limits this to minor physical breaks and retains landscape protection. Around inland lakes over 1,000 hectares, SCOT may identify sectors outside the 100-metre shore strip where coastal rules cease to apply; mountain rules remain. Rebuilt ruined pastoral huts are limited to pastoral or hiking use, without commercial activity or change of use, and require approval.
第10条把科西嘉部分无规划市镇禁止扩大城市化的起始年份从2027延至2030；不: Article 10 moves the start year of the development-extension ban in specified Corsican communes without planning documents from 2027 to 2030, not all mountain restrictions. Water storage is a policy objective excluding pumping from inert aquifers, not a substitute for project permits. Integration of existing flood works remains conditional and subject to a decree; local plan changes, permits and pending-application transitions are unverified.
912 DC：建设连续性及湖岸保护范围: 912 DC: development continuity and lake-shore protection
法国扩大姑息照护与家属支持框架，不限于最后几天: France broadens palliative care and family support beyond the final days of life
法律把姑息医疗与陪伴照护结合，面向各年龄重病患者及亲属，强调尽早、持续、多专业和: The law combines palliative medicine with supportive care for seriously ill patients of all ages and their families, emphasising early, continuous, multidisciplinary and home-accessible care. Assisted dying is governed separately by Law 2026-794.
此前已有姑息照护及预先医疗意愿制度；新法扩大照护定义、地方协调、个体计划与家属支: Palliative care and advance directives already existed. The law broadens the definition, local coordination, personalised planning and family support, and adds a public/nonprofit care-house framework.
诊断重病、慢性病恶化或开始失去自主能力时，应提出个性化陪伴计划，依患者意愿调整；: A personalised support plan should be proposed after serious diagnosis, deterioration of chronic disease or emerging loss of autonomy and revised with the patient’s wishes. Family involvement and digital-health storage require appropriate consent. The latest advance directive prevails; adults unable to speak may use alternative communication and do not thereby lose decision-making rights.
法律列明2026–2034年新增措施经费路径，2026年€1.94亿、2027年: The law sets a 2026–2034 funding path for new measures, including €194 million in 2026 and €192 million in 2027. These are not personal grants or evidence that every bed exists. Covered professional tasks prohibit balance billing; care-house tariffs are set through regional health-agency contracts. Support also covers families after bereavement.
延长或提高家庭陪护假补偿在第15条仍是政府研究报告要求，不能写成已提高到三个月或: Article 15 calls for a government report on extending or improving caregiver-leave compensation; it does not itself create three-month or one-year payments. Personalised plans and volunteer agreements involve implementing rules; beds, local services and migration of older documents are unverified. Existing directives do not automatically need rewriting; the latest version governs.
法国协助死亡法已公布，实际开放仍须核对实施规则: France promulgates an assisted-dying law; operational access still needs implementation verification
国民议会最终通过后，法律于8月18日公布签署、19日刊登公报；参议院此前否决没有: Following final National Assembly adoption, the law was promulgated on 18 August and published on 19 August; prior Senate rejection did not end the legislation. It establishes strict eligibility, medical collegial review and repeated confirmation of wishes. Operational application access is unconfirmed here, so enactment is not presented as immediate availability.
已有拒绝治疗、预先医疗意愿及姑息照护制度；5月2026-404号法律进一步加强照: Treatment refusal, advance directives and palliative care already existed, with care strengthened by May’s Law 2026-404. The new assisted-dying route coexists with these rights and does not replace the patient’s option of palliative care.
资格须同时满足成年、法国国籍或稳定合法居留、危及生命且处于晚期或终末期的严重不治: Eligibility cumulatively requires adulthood, French nationality or stable lawful residence, a serious incurable life-threatening condition in an advanced or terminal phase, related refractory suffering or suffering deemed unbearable after refusing treatment, and capacity for free and informed wishes. Psychological suffering alone is insufficient; advance directives cannot replace current capacity. Application and confirmation cannot be by teleconsultation.
医生在多专业合议后作有理由决定，法定通知期为正式申请后15天，批准后至少两天考虑: The doctor decides with reasons after multidisciplinary review, with statutory notification within 15 days of a formal request and at least two days’ reflection before confirmation. Wishes may be withdrawn and require reassessment after three months. Decision 910 DC requires consideration of legal-protector observations, recognises pharmacists’ conscientious refusal and allows private institutions to refuse where manifestly contrary to their mission and other local institutions can meet needs.
9月18日参议院实施页称无需规章，但最终文本第13、15、17条仍涉及程序、监督: The 18 September Senate tracker says no regulations are needed, while final articles 13, 15 and 17 refer to procedure, oversight and tariff rules; a ministry search result also says implementation texts are awaited, but its page is access-restricted. The conflict remains visible and no confirmed effective date is assigned. Death-insurance rules expressly extend to contracts existing at commencement; that transition is not evidence of operational access.
910 DC第121、166、188段及资格、保险审查: 910 DC paragraphs 121, 166 and 188 and eligibility/insurance review
法国扩展反恐及遣返羁押措施，宪法裁决限制追溯和强制精神检查: France expands security and removal-detention measures with constitutional limits on retroactivity and psychiatric examination
法律涉及强制精神检查、恐怖犯罪刑满后安全留置、行政监管、精神医疗信息及外国人遣返: The law covers psychiatric examination orders, post-sentence terrorist preventive detention, administrative monitoring, psychiatric information and immigration detention. Decision 906 DC upheld provisions with interpretive reservations; it does not permit automatic 540-day detention of any foreign national.
此前已有反恐监管及外国人羁押制度，普通遣返羁押通常最多90天，恐怖主义相关例外可: Counterterrorism monitoring and immigration detention already existed. Ordinary removal detention generally had a 90-day maximum, with terrorism-related exceptions reaching 180 days or exceptionally 210. The law widens narrowly defined exceptional categories and sets repeat-detention boundaries for the same removal decision.
超过90天的扩展例外须具现实、当前且特别严重的公共秩序威胁、列举的严重犯罪终局定: The extended over-90-day exception requires a real, current and particularly grave threat, final conviction for listed serious offences, a reasonable removal prospect and insufficient control by residence restrictions, with judicial authorisation each time. The same removal decision permits at most five placements and normally 360 cumulative days, exceptionally 540 in defined serious cases; normally at least 48 hours separate placements, and necessity/proportionality still apply each time.
强制精神检查只针对法定反恐及健康条件，需精神科意见及理由，可48小时内诉请审查；: Psychiatric examination orders require statutory terrorism/health conditions, a psychiatric opinion and reasons, with review sought within 48 hours; compulsory attendance requires judicial authority. Decision 906 DC requires notification of representatives, a judicial time limit and no more than 12 hours of compulsion, with admission certification from outside the receiving hospital. Administrative psychiatric notifications cannot include medical certificates, treatment details or prescriptions.
恐怖犯罪刑满后安全留置限特定至少15年刑期及特别危险条件；906 DC第66段禁: Post-sentence terrorist preventive detention requires specified offences, at least a 15-year sentence and particular dangerousness; paragraph 66 bars pre-commencement convictions or conduct. Name-change checks have a separate explanation. Although the tracker describes direct application, the ruling requires detailed psychiatric-opinion procedures; full implementation and individual or existing-detention transitions remain unverified.
906 DC：检查、隐私、追溯及羁押保障: 906 DC: examination, privacy, retroactivity and detention safeguards
法国刑事司法改革分阶段实施，重罪认罪程序未进入最终法律: France phases criminal-justice reform; the proposed felony plea procedure did not survive
法律调整受害者律师协助、刑事法院组织、庭前安排和诉讼期限；原拟“承认重罪审判”认: The law changes victim legal assistance, criminal-court organisation, trial preparation and procedural deadlines. 修法面对刑事法院积压及受害者程序保障；原有审判、防御和法官审查制度继续，新增规则: The reform addresses criminal-court backlogs and victim safeguards. Existing trial, defence and judicial-review protections continue, with new provisions subject to their individual transitions.
特定伴侣暴力受害者或15岁以下遭有权威者侵害儿童，在报案或首次询问时的律师与法律: Notice of lawyer/legal-aid rights at complaint or first interview for specified partner-violence victims and children under 15 abused by an ascendant or authority figure starts on 1 January 2027. Information about restorative justice expands, alongside changes to departmental criminal-court jurisdiction, staffing and trial preparation.
庭前证人、专家及审期安排须所有在场律师同意，只约束律师出席的当事方，仍须顾及辩护: Preparatory agreements on witnesses, experts and trial duration require all attending lawyers’ consent and bind only represented parties, subject to defence needs. Paragraph 68 of 909 DC constrains successive remote detention hearings. Article 9’s relevant nullity-application rules start three months after promulgation, on 23 October; its first two provisions apply to requests made from that date.
909 DC删除第5条I、II及III的6°a/e，第8条和第12条III，不能: Decision 909 DC strikes article 5 I/II and III(6)(a/e), article 8 and article 12 III; deleted clauses must not generate a 2027 implementation deadline. Article 12 distinguishes pending cases without judgment on the merits, minors and release applications; honorary-lawyer staffing clauses start on 1 January 2027. 909 DC删除条款及第10、12、68段解释保留: 909 DC deletions and reservations in paragraphs 10, 12 and 68

法国水电法改特许经营为授权路径，旧合同须等实际终止才转换: France changes hydropower concession rules while preserving old contracts until actual termination
法律为主要超过4500千瓦的水电特许经营设终止、补偿和70年物权安排，配合环境及: The law provides termination, compensation and 70-year real rights for principally over-4,500-kW hydropower concessions, alongside environmental/energy authorisations and virtual-capacity access. Its latest statutory commencement was 1 September; this does not mean every old contract ended then or household bills fell.
原有大水电以特许经营为主；新制度将相关经营权、公共资产占用、环境许可及竞争开放分: Large hydropower has principally operated under concessions. The new regime separates operating rights, public-property occupation, environmental authorisation and competitive access; safety, water-use and navigation obligations do not disappear.
相关现经营者取得70年物权及占用权前，须按程序评价终止补偿与所授权益价值；转让、: Before current operators receive 70-year real and occupation rights, termination compensation and the value of granted rights must be assessed. Transfers, mortgages and control changes face state-approval conditions, and new works still need permits. EDF initially makes 6 GW of virtual capacity available, targeting access to at least 40% of national hydro capacity outside its group, for 20 years from relevant termination and rights allocation.
第三方买到的是电力市场产品，不是大坝产权或运营控制。终止后环境授权过渡最长20年: Third parties buy electricity-market products, not dam ownership or operating control. Transitional environmental authorisation lasts at most 20 years after termination, retaining water, safety and navigation conditions until replaced. The special Rhône concession is excluded; treaty concessions require party agreement, with separate preservation rules for small installations and procurement already started.
第21条规定最迟2026年9月1日生效，同时旧特许经营在实际终止前继续按旧法；不: Article 21 sets commencement no later than 1 September 2026 while preserving the old regime until each concession actually terminates. Publication alone cannot end a contract. The 24 August tracker says no regulations are needed despite decree and CRE arrangements in the text. Individual terminations, auction launch, actual levy schedules and retail-price effects remain unverified.
法国职业体育法加强联盟治理和利益冲突规则，部分措施延后: France tightens professional-sport governance and conflicts rules with phased measures
法律改革体育总会、职业联盟、俱乐部、经纪人与转播商业安排，强调财务监管、男女职业: The law reforms federations, professional leagues, clubs, agents and broadcast-commercial arrangements, covering financial control, solidarity between men’s and women’s sport and supporter dialogue. It does not automatically dissolve a league or guarantee subscription prices or club income.
此前总会向职业联盟授权并签订协议；新法细化拒绝续期、撤回、调解及资产合同承接，同: Federations already subdelegated to professional leagues under agreements. The law specifies nonrenewal, withdrawal, mediation and succession to assets/contracts, while adding governance and conflict restrictions.
职业俱乐部代表在总会大会票权不得超过25%；总会选举候选人不得接受外国国家或境外: Professional-club representatives may hold no more than 25% of federation assembly votes. Election candidates cannot receive foreign-state or foreign-entity support, with a specified European credit exception. 撤回授权须理由、听取意见及部长批准等程序；解散后的资产、债务和劳动合同承接，并不: Withdrawal requires reasons, representations and ministerial approval. Assets, obligations and employment contracts pass on dissolution without thereby cancelling broadcast contracts. Article 28’s amendments on cross-border multi-club control risks and sanctions expressly exclude situations already established at commencement, rather than applying universally retrospectively.
经纪人L.222-8新制度从2028年1月1日开始并需过渡命令；虚拟广告及赞助试: The new L.222-8 sports-agent regime starts on 1 January 2028 with transitional rules; virtual advertising/sponsorship runs experimentally from 1 January 2027 to 30 June 2028 for specified events under regulatory conditions. This account explains governance and transitions, without verifying every implementing measure across all 46 articles, anti-piracy enforcement or individual federation compliance.
法国反欺诈法扩大核查与暂扣权限，仍须保护基本生活和医疗: France expands fraud checks and temporary suspension powers with subsistence and healthcare safeguards
新法加强税务、社保及France Travail核查、追偿和信息交换；904 D: The law strengthens tax, social-security and France Travail checks, recovery and information sharing. Decision 904 DC removes clauses and constrains data use and benefit suspension; suspicion is not a final finding of fraud.
原有社保核查、居住资格及追缴制度继续；新法增加指定人员取证和临时保护措施，不普遍: Existing checks, residence eligibility and recovery rules continue; the law adds designated-agent access and precautionary powers without generally abolishing eligibility.
France Travail在严重迹象下可有理由暂扣相关补助，最长三个月且不续期: France Travail may impose a reasoned precautionary suspension on serious indications for at most three months without renewal; social-security bodies require multiple serious indications and a two-month nonrenewable maximum. Reasons and remedies must be notified immediately, with an adversarial hearing within two weeks on request.
France Travail暂扣仍须保留家庭日常生活所需且不低于RSA标准；社保: France Travail suspension must preserve ordinary household needs and at least the RSA floor; social-security rules must preserve essential care for insured people and dependants. Banking/connection access is restricted to authorised agents, necessary data and statutory purposes; recovery must also preserve adequate living means.
第10、12、32条及第21条部分被删；条文编号以904 DC公布编号为准。本文: Articles 10, 12 and 32 and part of article 21 were struck; numbering follows 904 DC. 法国经济简化法调整审批，低排放区整体取消条款未生效: France streamlines economic approvals; blanket abolition of low-emission zones did not survive
法律涉及企业程序、商业租约及建设审批；903 DC删去大量无关附带条款，包括第3: The law covers business procedures, commercial leases and construction approvals. Decision 903 DC strikes numerous unrelated riders, including article 37 abolishing low-emission zones. Businesses must follow surviving provisions and implementing rules, not the unfiltered parliamentary bill.
规划、环境许可和商业审批原有框架继续；法律为特定国家重大项目、商业改造和小型公众: Planning, environmental and commercial approval frameworks remain, with conditional streamlined routes for specified major national projects, commercial restructuring and small premises open to the public.
国家重大项目范围扩大至部分基础设施及数据中心；地方建筑高度例外仍需命令。商业场所: Certain infrastructure/data centres enter the major-national-project framework; building-height derogations still require a decree. Specified commercial restructuring without added floor area or land take can avoid commercial authorisation. Under-300-square-metre public-access premises may use a compliance declaration only once implementing rules apply, retaining third-party safety/accessibility certification.
项目公共利益认定不自动替代所有环境许可；沿海通信天线仍受技术必要性、地方意见及国: Public-interest recognition does not automatically replace all environmental permits. Coastal telecom installations retain technical-necessity, local-opinion and prefectural conditions. Low-emission zones were not abolished by this law; local restrictions still require local checks.
7月16日主管部门说明确认多项细则待定。本篇解释审批主线，不覆盖全部84条或声称: The responsible ministry’s 16 July explanation identifies pending details. This account covers approvals, not all 84 articles or automatic conversion of pending applications; existing dedicated explanations such as commercial leases retain their narrower scope.

法国农业紧急法设置有限农药例外，水资源和公众参与保障继续: France creates limited agricultural pesticide exceptions while retaining water and participation safeguards
法律调整农业生产、植保、水资源、土地及收益制度；914 DC删除部分条款并作解释: The law changes production, crop protection, water, land and farm-income rules. Decision 914 DC removes provisions and imposes safeguards. It neither universally restores banned pesticides nor automatically permits reservoirs or livestock projects.
欧盟产品授权、健康环境保护和项目审批仍适用；法国国内禁令只在列举作物、物质及严重: EU product authorisation, health/environment protection and project approvals remain applicable; domestic prohibitions admit temporary exceptions only for specified crops/substances and serious production threats.
甜菜、樱桃、苹果及榛子相关例外须ANSES决定、替代办法不存在或明显不足、研发计: Relevant sugar-beet, cherry, apple and hazelnut exceptions require ANSES approval, absent or clearly inadequate alternatives, research plans and risk controls. Sugar beet is limited to flupyradifurone-treated seed, excluding spraying. The framework expires three years after promulgation; individual permissions cannot exceed statutory limits.
914 DC要求ANSES可按当地威胁缩小地域范围；两个月内未能核实全部条件意味: ANSES must be able to narrow geographic scope according to local threats. Failure to verify all conditions within two months means refusal, not tacit approval. Significant health risks or serious irreversible environmental damage bar permission; permissions end when conditions cease. Water priorities retain environmental safeguards.
被删内容包括第16、26、32、35、36、55条及第46条限制公众参与的部分。: Deleted provisions include articles 16, 26, 32, 35, 36 and 55 and part of article 46 restricting participation. This account focuses on crop protection/environmental boundaries; individual ANSES permissions, pending-project transitions, all subsidies and implementing rules remain unverified. Existing EU authorisation alone does not grant this exception.
法国公共秩序法扩大部分执法措施，宪法裁决删除自动处罚等条款: France widens selected enforcement powers with constitutional deletions and safeguards
法律涉及商业管理、体育活动、非法占用、监控和刑事程序；915 DC部分否决并附多: The law covers commercial controls, sporting events, unlawful occupation, surveillance and criminal procedure. Decision 915 DC partially strikes provisions and imposes safeguards. Removal of a specific illicit-tobacco clause does not defeat the whole law.
行政驱离和活动安保本已有法定条件；新法扩大部分适用场景，仍须遵守理由、比例原则、: Administrative eviction and event security already had statutory conditions. The law extends selected situations while retaining reasons, proportionality, judicial remedies and constitutional interpretation.
体育赛事特定地点禁入最长24小时，须有严重扰乱及再犯风险，排除住所和工作场所并顾: Specified sports-event exclusion orders last at most 24 hours and require serious disorder and recurrence risks; home/work locations are excluded and family/work life and cumulative restrictions matter. Administrative eviction extends to unlawfully occupied commercial/agricultural/professional premises, but not where the occupant has established a home there.
紧急空中摄像仅针对不可预测且严重迫近的安全风险，须有理由授权、必要地域及较少侵扰: Emergency aerial filming requires an unforeseeable grave imminent security risk, reasoned authorisation, necessary geographic scope and assessment of less intrusive alternatives. Formalisation is required within one hour or filming stops and recordings are deleted. The 72-hour maximum runs from authorisation and must be shortened where proportionality requires.
915 DC删除第1条部分、第10、18、26、41、65条及其他部分，包括有组: Decision 915 DC deletes parts of article 1, articles 10, 18, 26, 41 and 65 and other provisions, including automatic denial of all temporary release in organised-crime prison units. This account does not verify implementation across all 65 articles, individual transitions or administrative orders.
法国上调2024—2030国防规划，国家安全警戒仍须另行启动: France increases defence planning; national-security alert powers require separate activation
法律为2026—2030增加360亿欧元规划资源，并建立国家安全警戒及相关采购制: The law adds EUR 36 billion to planned resources for 2026–2030 and establishes national-security alert and related procurement rules. Programming is not expenditure already made, and promulgation does not itself declare an alert or mobilisation.
2023年原定2024—2030国防任务支付额度表为4000亿欧元；更新表约43: The 2023 trajectory listed EUR 400 billion in defence-mission payment appropriations for 2024–2030; the revised table shows about EUR 436 billion, with an exact EUR 435.7 billion noted. Rounded rows should not be treated as exact arithmetic.
2026年规划由537亿增至571亿，2030年由674亿增至757亿；国防投入: The 2026 trajectory rises from EUR 53.7bn to 57.1bn and 2030 from 67.4bn to 75.7bn; the defence-effort target is at least 2.5% of GDP in 2030 and 3.5% in 2035. These remain plans/targets subject to annual budgets and actual execution.
国家安全警戒须根据具体、严重且当前的威胁，由内阁命令在指定地域启动，可向最高行政: A national-security alert requires a cabinet decree, specified territory and a materially established grave current threat, subject to Conseil d’État review. Exceptional procurement and temporary facility expansion must be necessary to address that threat; the statute alone does not establish a specific requisition of a business or person.
907 DC确认受审条款合宪，并不确认每项执行措施。本文解释预算轨迹及警戒制度；: Decision 907 DC upholds the challenged clauses, not every implementing action. This account covers budget trajectories and the alert framework; personnel/intelligence implementation across 57 articles, existing-contract transitions, alert activation and actual spending remain unverified.
法国2030冬奥法设临时规划、交通和周日营业规则: France sets temporary planning, transport and Sunday-work rules for the 2030 Winter Games
法律为法国阿尔卑斯2030冬奥及冬残奥组织、建设与安保提供专门规则。部分例外仅在: The law sets specific organisation, construction and security rules for the French Alps 2030 Winter Olympics and Paralympics. Some exceptions apply only at specified locations/times in 2030, rather than permanently from 2026.
一般规划审批、环境参与和周日休息规则继续；奥运项目及有关商业活动获得限定例外，具: Ordinary planning, environmental participation and Sunday-rest rules continue, with limited exceptions for Games projects and relevant businesses requiring subsequent designation or activation.
2020年代筹备的临时建筑例外限奥运所需，安装最长三年，用后恢复场地最长18个月: Temporary-building exceptions are restricted to Games needs, with installation at most three years and restoration within 18 months after use. Reserved traffic lanes may operate from 1 January to 31 March 2030 in host and neighbouring departments, with duration proportionate to safety and traffic purposes.
有关地区零售场所周日营业例外亦限2030年1—3月，须行政批准；员工自愿书面同意: Relevant retail Sunday-opening exceptions also run only in January–March 2030 and require administrative approval. Employees must consent voluntarily in writing and can withdraw on ten clear days’ notice; refusal cannot justify recruitment rejection, discipline or discrimination. Decision 902 DC separately protects family/work life and cumulative-duration limits in major-event counterterrorism exclusion orders.
本篇不认定具体道路已封闭、商店已获许可或旧租赁自动终止。算法视频试验后来又受20: This account does not establish actual road closures, store permissions or automatic termination of existing leases. Algorithmic-video experimentation was subsequently amended by public-order Law 2026-798, so the March law alone does not establish current surveillance rules; project, compensation and housing-transition implementation remains incompletely verified.
法国2026财政法已通过：2025收入税阶上调0.9%，高收入附加税延续: France’s 2026 Finance Act indexes 2025-income tax thresholds and extends the high-income contribution
2026财政法已正式通过，早期否决或年初临时财政安排不是最终状态。第4条把202: The 2026 Finance Act was enacted; earlier rejections and the temporary start-of-year arrangements are not its final status. Article 4 indexes thresholds for 2025 income declared in 2026 by 0.9%; article 2 extends the differential high-income contribution and provides advance payment.
原免税分界为每税份11497欧元，现为11600；其余分界从29315、8382: The zero-rate threshold per tax share rises from EUR 11,497 to 11,600; remaining boundaries rise from 29,315/83,823/180,294 to 29,579/84,577/181,917. Threshold indexation does not imply every household’s tax falls by 0.9%.
税率仍为0%、11%、30%、41%、45%，逐段对家庭份额后的应税收入适用；通: Rates remain 0%, 11%, 30%, 41% and 45%, applied progressively to taxable income divided by household tax shares. The usual additional half-share benefit cap rises from EUR 1,791 to 1,807. Tax-authority guidance dated 7 April confirms application to tax due in 2026 on 2025 income.
高收入差额贡献不在2025后自动结束；法律以相关年度决算法案确认一般预算赤字低于: The differential high-income contribution does not automatically end after 2025; its sunset depends on the relevant accounts bill recording a general-budget deficit below 3% of GDP. An advance of 95% of estimated liability is payable on 1–15 December, with excess refunded on assessment; a transition excludes specified income subject to final withholding before publication in 2026.
本文解释个人税阶及高收入贡献的主要过渡，未逐项覆盖整部财政法；高收入资格、修正收: This overview explains household thresholds and key contribution transitions, not every Finance Act provision. High-income eligibility, adjusted income base, credits and individual advances require article 224 and tax guidance. The 2027 Finance Bill remains a separate proposal and does not replace enacted 2026 rules.
法国南部大区：免缴所得税家庭可申请250欧元E85改装补助: Région Sud: income-tax-exempt households can apply for a EUR 250 E85 conversion grant
申请期为9月15日至10月30日，每税务家庭最多一次250欧元，用于授权专业人员: Applications run from 15 September to 30 October: one EUR 250 grant per tax household for an approved E85 conversion installed by an authorised professional. The EUR 500,000 budget does not guarantee every application an award.

面向非应纳所得税家庭，涵盖汽油车合规装置的供应和安装，直接付给获批受益人。公告未: The grant targets households not liable to income tax, covers supply/installation of an approved device on a petrol vehicle, and is paid directly to approved recipients. 法国南部大区推出流动乳腺筛查车，具体巡诊须查当地日程: Région Sud launches mobile breast screening, with local visits subject to the schedule
10月1日大区发布流动乳腺摄影服务，计划走访六个省，帮助远离影像服务或参与率偏低: On 1 October the region announced a mobile mammography service intended to visit all six departments and improve organised-screening access in underserved or low-participation areas. Launch does not establish appointments in every municipality.
既有有组织筛查及2022—2027区域癌症计划继续；流动服务补充固定影像中心，解: Existing organised screening and the 2022–2027 regional cancer plan continue; mobile provision supplements fixed imaging centres to address distance and transport barriers.
大区表示车辆将覆盖普罗旺斯—阿尔卑斯—蓝色海岸六省，并提供巡回日程入口。计划40: The region states that the vehicle will cover the six Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur departments and links to a touring schedule. EUR 40 million is the regional cancer-plan envelope, not cash per patient or this vehicle’s individual budget.
居民应核实当地到访时间、筛查资格及预约方式；本公告不改变全国筛查年龄、频次或报销: Residents need to verify local visit dates, screening eligibility and booking arrangements. The announcement does not change national screening ages, intervals or reimbursement rules and does not establish an individual clinical indication.
本轮核实服务启动与覆盖目标，未核实每个站点容量、预约余位或后续实际完成量。原有患: This review confirms the launch and intended coverage, not every stop’s capacity, appointment availability or later delivery. Existing patient pathways are not automatically changed by the launch.
法国税务居民的调整后家庭参考收入须超过单身等25万欧元、共同申报50万欧元，且所: French tax residents enter the differential-contribution calculation when adjusted household reference income exceeds EUR 250,000 for single and equivalent filers or EUR 500,000 for joint filers and relevant income tax, the existing high-income contribution and final withholding total less than 20% of adjusted reference income; deductions and family adjustments also matter. This fills a difference, not an extra 20% levy on income. It continues through the year whose accounts bill records a general-budget deficit below 3% of GDP. The 1–15 December advance is 95% of estimated contribution: a hypothetical EUR 10,000 liability requires EUR 9,500 upfront. Specified pre-publication final-withholding income has a 2026 transition exclusion.

巴符州警方与检方原则上公布嫌疑人国籍，未成年人仍受特别保护: Baden-Württemberg generally names suspects’ nationality, with special protection for minors
警方和检方发布个案消息时，原则上说明嫌疑人的国籍；涉及调查、保密或个人权利的例外: Police and prosecutors generally state suspects’ nationality in case announcements. Investigation, confidentiality and personal-rights exceptions remain. This default does not apply to minors and victims.

新行政规定把公布改为默认，只有更重要的公共利益或应保护的个人利益阻止时才不公布。: The revised administrative rule makes disclosure the default unless overriding public interests or protected personal interests prevent it.
影响巴符州刑事案件的公开报道，以及被报道的嫌疑人。: Affects public reporting of criminal cases in Baden-Württemberg and the suspects concerned.
妨碍调查、保密义务、可识别个人的受保护人格权均可构成例外。儿童、青少年嫌疑人及受: Exceptions include interference with proceedings, secrecy obligations and protected personality rights of identifiable individuals. 巴符州追加7万欧元除蜂巢补助，参与项目的专业人员每巢获200欧元: Baden-Württemberg adds EUR 70,000 for hornet-nest removal; participating professionals receive EUR 200 per nest
追加资金用于把亚洲胡蜂次生巢清除补助延续到深秋。每个符合项目要求的次生巢补助20: Additional funding extends Asian hornet secondary-nest removal support into late autumn. EUR 200 per eligible secondary nest goes to qualified, registered removers, not residents who report nests.

州追加总额7万欧元，继续每个次生巢200欧元的补助。领取补助的人员不得再向委托人: The state adds EUR 70,000 in total and retains EUR 200 per secondary nest. A remover using the subsidy must not invoice the customer.
例如住户委托一名参加项目的登记人员清除一个符合条件的次生巢，200欧元由项目补助: For example, for one eligible secondary nest removed by a registered participant, the programme pays the remover EUR 200 and the resident should not receive an additional invoice for that service.

黑森开通全州统一的死亡野猪在线报告入口，无需注册: Hesse launches a statewide online reporting service for dead wild boar without registration
在黑森发现死亡野猪，可用新表单提交动物和位置资料，手机GPS或地图定位后直接转给: Dead wild boar found in Hesse can be reported through a new form with animal and location details; GPS or a map identifies the site and routes the report to the competent veterinary authority.

统一入口面向全州，无需账号；报告送达所在县或独立市的主管机关。: A single statewide service requires no account and sends reports to the relevant district or independent city authority.
方便发现死亡野猪的居民和土地使用者，帮助主管机关定位并安排检查。: Helps residents and land users report finds and enables authorities to locate and investigate them.
限制区内既有报告义务不因新增网上入口而取消；其他地区也鼓励报告。公告没有宣布全州: Existing reporting duties inside restriction zones remain, while reporting elsewhere is encouraged. The announcement does not introduce a statewide new penalty or exclusion zone.
勃兰登堡三家法院试点为家暴保护程序提供心理社会陪伴: Three Brandenburg courts pilot psychosocial support in domestic-violence protection proceedings
家暴受害者在家庭法院申请保护措施时，可在试点中获得专业陪伴，帮助理解程序、缓解负: A pilot supports domestic-violence victims seeking family-court protection, helping them understand proceedings and manage distress. The participating local courts are Brandenburg an der Havel, Bernau and Neuruppin.
心理社会诉讼陪伴已用于刑事程序；家庭法院的暴力保护程序是本次试点扩展的范围。: Psychosocial court support is established in criminal proceedings; this pilot extends testing to family-court violence-protection proceedings.
10月12日启动试点，由Opferhilfe Land Brandenburg协: The pilot launched on 12 October, coordinated locally by Opferhilfe Land Brandenburg. The nationwide project has EUR 3 million in federal funding through the end of 2027, plus EUR 2 million for a national awareness campaign.
服务针对参加法院的相关保护程序，帮助受害者实际使用法院保护途径。300万欧元是全: Supports relevant proceedings at participating courts so victims can access judicial protection. EUR 3 million is the nationwide programme budget, not individual compensation.
陪伴不替代律师或治疗。试点还涉及巴符、北威和石荷三州，但本条只说明勃兰登堡实施点: Support does not replace a lawyer or therapy. Baden-Württemberg, North Rhine-Westphalia and Schleswig-Holstein also participate, but this entry covers Brandenburg’s sites. This is not yet a permanent universal entitlement at every family court.

主要涉及沿海捕虾、贝类渔业及港口社区，需要关注后续法案的具体区域。: Primarily affects coastal shrimp and shellfish fisheries and port communities, which need the eventual bill’s precise boundaries.
现行禁渔规则继续适用，拟新增部分没有已核实的生效日。环保团体主张更广保护范围；协: Existing exclusions remain applicable. No verified commencement date exists for the proposed additions. Environmental groups sought wider protection; a negotiated plan does not establish unanimous agreement on every detail.

采购包括LNVG的83列及布伦瑞克地区的30列电池列车，并建设维修配套。最早计划: The order covers 83 battery trains for LNVG and 30 for the Braunschweig area, with maintenance facilities. Initial service is planned for late 2031 on the Weser-Leine and Harz-Heide networks; today’s announcement does not change timetables.
相关非电气化线路仍需逐步替换柴油车辆，并建设维修设施。: Diesel fleets on relevant unelectrified routes need gradual replacement and supporting maintenance facilities.
订购Mireo Plus B列车，配套规划Goslar和Soltau维修基地及3: Mireo Plus B trains are ordered with planned depots in Goslar and Soltau and thirty years of manufacturer maintenance. They can charge under overhead wires and use batteries on unelectrified sections.
未来乘客可获得无障碍上下车、更多多用途空间和自行车位；具体线路和投运时间仍以实施: Future passengers are expected to gain accessible boarding, multipurpose space and bicycle capacity; routes and timing remain subject to implementation.
官方标题称超过20亿欧元，正文称车辆采购约10亿欧元并另列维修等配套，但未清楚对: The official headline says over EUR 2 billion, while the body describes about EUR 1 billion for the trains plus maintenance-related elements without clearly reconciling the totals. This entry does not present them as one verified amount or invent a day for “late 2031”.

相关通勤者的未来服务计划改善；这不是今天立即加开列车。: Improves the outlook for affected commuters; it does not add trains today.

勃兰登堡所有建筑审批机关接入网上平台，可全程数字办理: All Brandenburg building authorities join a platform for fully digital permit processing

2024年先在Oberspreewald-Lausitz试点，随后逐步扩展；此前: A pilot began in Oberspreewald-Lausitz in 2024 and expanded gradually; the earlier process normally used three paper files.
10月6日州部门确认已完成全州接入，平台连接机关内部办案系统。: On 6 October the ministry confirmed statewide connection, integrated with authorities’ case-management systems.
在勃兰登堡申请建筑许可的人可减少打印、签字和邮寄的往返。: Building-permit applicants in Brandenburg can reduce printing, signing and postal exchanges.
平台可能缩短流程，但公告没有保证固定审批天数，也没有取消建设许可本身或法定条件。: The platform may shorten processing, but the announcement guarantees no fixed turnaround and does not remove permits or statutory requirements.
下萨克森污水收费行政改革2027年生效，另调整部分风电配套道路环评范围: Lower Saxony changes wastewater-charge administration in 2027 and adjusts assessment scope for some wind-farm roads
10月13日公布的法律从2027年1月1日起，把污水排放费执行机关明确为州水务、: The law published on 13 October takes effect on 1 January 2027 and designates NLWKN, the state water, coastal and nature authority, to administer wastewater discharge charges. This administrative and procedural reform does not establish a uniform increase or reduction in household sewer bills.
旧版州实施法和1984年地方拨款条例继续适用至新法生效；新法对这些行政条款作替换: The previous state implementing law and the 1984 local-allocation ordinance remain applicable until commencement; the new act replaces those administrative provisions.
明确主管机关；把州实施法第10条第4款第二句中的2月10日改为10月10日；地方: The act identifies the authority, changes 10 February to 10 October in section 10(4), sentence 2, and specifies EUR 2.56 administrative-cost allocation per municipal discharge-charge pass-through notice. It also excludes roads wholly within onshore wind acceleration areas serving wind-farm construction or access from the relevant state environmental-assessment list entry.
主要影响排污缴费主体、地方政府、主管机关及符合条件的风电配套道路项目。2.56欧: Primarily affects discharge-charge payers, municipalities, authorities and qualifying wind-farm access projects. EUR 2.56 is an administrative-cost allocation, not a new household charge.
道路条目豁免不等于所有风电项目免环评或免其他许可。第10条日期仅针对指定法条的程: The road-list exemption does not exempt every wind project from environmental assessment or other permits. The section-10 date concerns that specific procedure, not a universal filing deadline; this review does not separately explain that procedure.
下萨克森新农业土地法2027年4月14日生效，覆盖买卖、租赁和部分公司收购: Lower Saxony’s agricultural land law starts on 14 April 2027, covering sales, leases and some company acquisitions
土地买卖者、农场和收购农业公司的投资人需要关注：新法已正式公布，但要到2027年: Land buyers and sellers, farms and investors acquiring agricultural companies should note that the published law takes effect only on 14 April 2027. It revises sale approval, lease notification and consent requirements for some controlling acquisitions.
用于核对新法实施前的0.5公顷门槛及例外。: Used to check the current 0.5-hectare threshold and exceptions before the new law starts.
现行官方办事说明一般要求0.5公顷起的农业土地交易审批，另有法定例外；新法生效前: Current official service guidance generally requires approval for agricultural land sales from 0.5 hectares, subject to statutory exceptions. The existing rules continue before commencement.
新法一般豁免小于1公顷的出售，但须合并同一主管机关辖区内同时出售和此前三年免批出: Sales below one hectare are generally exempt under the new law, but relevant simultaneous sales and exempt sales during the preceding three years within the same authority’s area are aggregated. Splitting a sale is not a simple escape. Leases below 0.5 hectares and other specified cases are exempt from notification; others generally must be notified within one month. Some controlling company acquisitions require prior consent.
例如一块0.8公顷土地，在新法下不能仅凭单块面积认定免批：还要查看同一卖方相关三: For example, a 0.8-hectare sale cannot be assumed exempt solely from its size: relevant three-year sales by the same seller must also be checked. Company-acquisition rules require land assets of at least 40% and at least ten hectares in the state for farming companies, or at least 90% and five hectares for non-farming companies, together with controlling influence.
生效前已经启动的行政审批、申报、异议和司法程序继续用旧法。价格高于市场价值35%: Administrative approval, notification, objection and judicial proceedings begun before commencement retain the old law. The usual 35%-above-market-value test has statutory conditions and exceptions rather than automatically prohibiting every transaction; agricultural lease rules are not residential rent caps. The act also amends chamber and judicial provisions.

下萨克森三县获约67.4万欧元建设AI政务服务: Three Lower Saxony districts receive about EUR 674,000 for AI administration services
资金用于Verden、Diepholz、Nienburg联合项目；自动辅助不替代: Funding supports a joint Verden, Diepholz and Nienburg project; automated assistance does not replace final staff review.

公告确认规划审批并展示文件；不能把展示截止日当作通用起诉期限。: The announcement confirms planning approval and public document display; the display deadline is not a universal litigation deadline.
Obernkirchen工业用地项目获约103万欧元资助: Obernkirchen commercial-site project receives about EUR 1.03 million

新增的是照护信息资源，不是护理保险给付或资格变化。: This expands information resources, not care-insurance benefits or eligibility.

中央学习空间10月10日启用，整个项目运行至2030年底，另有卫星和移动学习空间: The central space opened on 10 October; the programme runs through 2030 with satellite and mobile spaces also planned.
现行《军人法》第59、61条已允许对部分前职业军人和定期服役人员强制安排演习；其: Sections 59 and 61 of the current Soldiers Act already permit compulsory exercises for some former career and fixed-term soldiers. 草案尚未通过。拟定过渡条款排除截至2011年6月30日仅服过基本兵役的人，以及新: The bill is not enacted. Proposed section 46 exempts people who had only completed basic military service by 30 June 2011 and those committed to the specified voluntary service before commencement. 截至10月13日：政府草案尚未通过；10月15日计划一读。: As of 13 October, the government bill is not enacted; first reading is scheduled for 15 October.

政府向州议会提交保费补贴反提案，拟以参考保费占可支配收入10.5%为社会目标，计: The government has submitted a premium-subsidy counterproposal targeting reference premiums at 10.5% of disposable income, with implementation planned for 2028. The 10% popular initiative remains an alternative.
弗里堡：保费补贴10.5%反提案提交议会，仍未通过: Fribourg: 10.5% premium-subsidy counterproposal submitted, not enacted
用于核对现行基线、提案阶段、范围和过渡；不以附件标题推定通过。: Used to check the current baseline, proposal stage, scope and transition; an attachment title does not establish enactment.
现行补贴按家庭类别收入门槛与参考保费计算，通常补贴比例为参考保费的1%至65%；: Current subsidies use household-category income thresholds and a reference premium, normally covering 1–65% of that reference amount. Children and dependent young adults have separate federal minimum-subsidy protections.
拟取消原来的家庭类别收入截断门槛，以联邦公布的平均保费和可支配收入计算差额；补贴: The proposal replaces existing household-category cut-offs with a calculation using federally published average premiums and disposable income, allowing subsidies beyond the previous 65% limit. 预计受益人数约11.6万，比2025年多2.1万；这不等于每户实际所选保险的账单: An estimated 116,000 people could benefit, 21,000 more than in 2025. This does not automatically cap every household’s chosen insurance bill at 10.5%.
仍属草案。拟保留高收入递减规则、资产门槛及依职权估税排除；补贴不得超过实际基本保: This is a bill. 影响承担专项社会服务的机构经费，不是向所有居民新增生活补助。: The change concerns funding for specialist social-service organisations, not a new payment to all residents.

法国：加密币换成稳定币拟从2027年起计税，目前只获财政委员会通过: France: swapping crypto for stablecoins would become taxable from 2027 — so far only approved by the Finance Committee
现行法下，法国个人把比特币等换成USDC、EURC等稳定币通常不计税，换回欧元或: Under current law, an individual in France who swaps bitcoin or similar assets for stablecoins such as USDC or EURC normally pays no tax at that point; tax arises when converting back to euros or paying for goods or services with crypto. Amendment I-CF1826 would treat a swap into a fiat-pegged stablecoin (an e-money token under MiCA) as a taxable sale from 1 January 2027. The committee also approved a 10-year loss carry-forward, an exit tax on crypto holdings above EUR 800,000 and reporting of self-custody wallets worth EUR 100,000 or more. None of these is law.
现行规则：个人把加密资产换成欧元等法定货币，或用来购买商品服务时，才计算收益纳税: Current rule: an individual calculates and pays tax on gains only when converting crypto into euros or another fiat currency, or using it to buy goods or services; crypto-to-crypto swaps (including into stablecoins) defer the tax. Sale gains are usually taxed at the 31.4% flat rate (see the separate explanation of the 2026 Social Security Financing Act). A year's losses can only offset that same year's gains and cannot be carried forward.
若I-CF1826原文最终成为法律：2027年1月1日起，换成电子货币代币就要按: If I-CF1826 becomes law as drafted: from 1 January 2027, a swap into an e-money token would trigger tax on the gain, measured by the value received; swaps into other, non-stablecoin crypto-assets would still defer tax. Gains would be calculated from the weighted average purchase cost of the same asset rather than across the whole portfolio. For coins bought before 2027, taxpayers would make a one-time choice: the actual cost of each coin, or the portfolio's total cost at 31 December 2026 split across coins in proportion to their market value on that date.
假设：2026年用1,000欧元买入比特币，2027年3月涨到3,000欧元时全: Hypothetical: you buy bitcoin for EUR 1,000 in 2026; in March 2027 it is worth EUR 3,000 and you swap all of it for USDC, without converting back to euros. Under current law that swap is not taxed. If I-CF1826 becomes law unchanged, the swap produces a taxable gain of about EUR 2,000; at today's 31.4% flat rate the tax would be about EUR 628 (ignoring fees and personal circumstances). The rate applies to the gain, not to the amount swapped. Swapping into ether or another non-stablecoin asset would still defer tax.
只涉及法国税务居民个人的非职业加密资产收益，企业和职业交易另有规则。I-CF18: Covers only non-professional crypto gains of individuals resident in France for tax purposes; businesses and professional trading follow other rules. I-CF1826 targets only e-money tokens as defined by MiCA; whether a given stablecoin qualifies depends on its legal classification. The committee rejected I-CF1564, which would have exempted up to EUR 1,000 a year of purchases paid in crypto. The Actual Return Box 3 Act (no. 36.748) would tax actual returns from 2028: each year's rise or fall in a crypto-asset, including paper gains not yet sold, would count as taxable income. The House of Representatives passed it in February; the Senate has put its vote on hold. On 30 September the government announced an amending bill: from 2028 financial instruments such as shares and bonds would be taxed on gains only when sold, but the state secretary confirmed in the House that directly held crypto-assets are not included and would move to taxation on sale only in 2030.

If the actual return is lower than the deemed return, the actual return can be declared (counter-evidence rule).
若法案按众议院通过版本生效（2028年1月1日起）：加密资产按“资产增值税”方式: If the bill takes effect as passed by the House (from 1 January 2028): crypto-assets are taxed under an "accrual" system, with each year's actual return (including unrealised changes in value) taxable, costs deductible and losses carried forward; only real estate and start-up shares are taxed on sale. If the government's announced amending bill passes: from 2028 all financial instruments are taxed on sale; directly held crypto-assets stay under the accrual system in 2028–2029 and move to taxation on sale from 2030. The government also proposes to cut the tax-free allowance to EUR 30,846 in 2027 and raise the deemed return for "other assets" (including crypto-assets) by 1.5 percentage points; from 2028 each person would have EUR 1,000 of tax-free return per year.

In 2027, if the government's plan passes, the allowance is roughly halved and the deemed return rises, so tax increases. From 2028, if the new system takes effect, tax is due on gains in years when prices rise even without selling, and falling years create losses that can be carried forward; people holding crypto exchange-traded products (such as crypto ETFs) may be taxed only on sale because these are financial instruments, so the two could be treated differently.

美国国税局2026年版1099-DA说明规定：经纪商对2026年起替客户完成的数: The IRS 2026 Form 1099-DA instructions require brokers to report gross proceeds for digital asset sales effected for customers from 2026, and also cost basis for assets acquired after 2025 in that broker's custodial account (covered securities). 美国纳税人：2027年初收到的2026年度1099-DA，会显示在平台上新买入资: US taxpayers: the 2026 Form 1099-DA received in early 2027 will show the cost of assets newly bought on the platform; for assets bought before 2025 or transferred in, platforms need not report cost, and taxpayers must keep and report it themselves.
